Allāh akbar hādhā al-baḥr qad dhakharā wa-hayyaja al-rīḥ mawjan yaqdhif al-durarā fa-khlaʿ thiyābaka wa-ghraq fīhi wa-daʿ ʿanka al-sibāḥa laysa al-sabīḥ muftakhirā.

God is most great! This sea has laid up its stores, and the wind has stirred a wave that casts forth pearls. Strip off your garments and drown in it; abandon swimming, for the swimmer has nothing to boast of.

46

و انّک انت لو تکون من اهل هذه المدینة فی هذه اللّجّة الأحدیّة لتری کلّ النّبیّین و المرسلین کهیکل واحد و نفس واحدة و نور واحد و روح واحدة بحیث یکون اوّلهم آخرهم و آخرهم اوّلهم و کلّهم قاموا علی امر اللّه و شرعوا شرائع حکمة اللّه و کانوا مظاهر نفس اللّه و معادن قدرة اللّه و مخازن وحی اللّه و مشارق شمس اللّه و مطالع نور اللّه و بهم ظهرت آیات التّجرید فی حقائق الممکنات و علامات التّفرید فی جوهریّات الموجودات و عناصر التّمجید فی ذاتیّات الأحدیّات و مواقع التّحمید فی ساذجیّات الصّمدیّات و بهم یبدأ الخلق و الیهم یعید کلّ المذکورات کما انّهم فی حقائقهم کانوا انواراً واحدةً و اسراراً واحدةً و کذلک فاشهد فی ظواهرهم لتعرف کلّهم علی هیکل واحد بل تجدهم علی لفظ واحد و کلام واحد و بیان واحد

Wa-innaka anta law takūn min ahl hādhihi al-madīna fī hādhihi al-lujja al-aḥadiyya la-tarā kull al-nabiyyīn wa-l-mursalīn ka-haykal wāḥid wa-nafs wāḥida wa-nūr wāḥid wa-rūḥ wāḥida bi-ḥayth yakūn awwaluhum ākhirahum wa-ākhiruhum awwalahum wa-kulluhum qāmū ʿalā amr Allāh wa-sharaʿū sharāʾiʿ ḥikmat Allāh wa-kānū maẓāhir nafs Allāh wa-maʿādin qudrat Allāh wa-makhāzin waḥy Allāh wa-mashāriq shams Allāh wa-maṭāliʿ nūr Allāh. Wa-bihim ẓaharat āyāt al-tajrīd fī ḥaqāʾiq al-mumkināt wa-ʿalāmāt al-tafrīd fī jawhariyyāt al-mawjūdāt wa-ʿanāṣir al-tamjīd fī dhātiyyāt al-aḥadiyyāt wa-mawāqiʿ al-taḥmīd fī sādhajiyyāt al-ṣamadiyyāt wa-bihim yabdaʾ al-khalq wa-ilayhim yuʿīd kull al-madhkūrāt. Kamā annahum fī ḥaqāʾiqihim kānū anwāran wāḥida wa-asrāran wāḥida wa-kadhālika fa-shhad fī ẓawāhirihim li-taʿrif kullahum ʿalā haykal wāḥid bal tajidahum ʿalā lafẓ wāḥid wa-kalām wāḥid wa-bayān wāḥid.

If you belong to this city within these depths of oneness, you will see all the Prophets and Messengers as one temple, one self, one light, and one spirit, so that their first is their last and their last is their first. All arose for the Cause of God, ordained the laws of God’s wisdom, and were the Manifestations of God’s Self, the mines of God’s power, the treasuries of God’s revelation, the dawning places of God’s sun, and the daysprings of God’s light. Through them the signs of detachment appeared in the realities of contingent beings, the tokens of singleness in the essences of existing things, the elements of glorification in the essential realities of oneness, and the seats of praise in the pure realities of eternal self-sufficiency. Through them He originates creation, and to them He returns all things that can be mentioned. Just as in their inner realities they are one in light and one in mystery, so behold them in their outward appearances, that you may recognize them all as one temple—indeed, find them to be one utterance, one discourse, and one exposition.

47

و انّک فی ذلک المقام لو تطلق اوّلهم باسم آخرهم او بالعکس لحقّ کما نزل حکم ذلک عن مصدر الألوهیّة و منبع الرّبوبیّة قل ادعوا اللّه او ادعوا الرّحمن ایّا ما تدعوا فله الأسمآء الحسنی لأنّهم مظاهر اسم اللّه و مطالع صفاته و مواقع قدرته و مجامع سلطنته و انّه جلّ و عزّ بذاته مقدّس عن کلّ الأسمآء و منزّه عن معارج الصّفات و کذلک فانظر آثار قدرة اللّه فی آفاق ارواحهم و انفس هیاکلهم لیطمئنّ قلبک و تکون من الّذینهم کانوا فی آفاق القرب لسائرین

Wa-innaka fī dhālik al-maqām law tuṭliq awwalahum bi-ism ākhirihim aw bi-l-ʿaks la-ḥaqq kamā nazala ḥukm dhālik ʿan maṣdar al-ulūhiyya wa-manbaʿ al-rubūbiyya qul udʿū Allāh aw udʿū al-Raḥmān ayyan mā tadʿū fa-lahu al-asmāʾ al-ḥusnā li-annahum maẓāhir ism Allāh wa-maṭāliʿ ṣifātihi wa-mawāqiʿ qudratihi wa-majāmiʿ salṭanatihi wa-innahu jalla wa-ʿazza bi-dhātihi muqaddas ʿan kull al-asmāʾ wa-munazzah ʿan maʿārij al-ṣifāt. Wa-kadhālika fa-nẓur āthār qudrat Allāh fī āfāq arwāḥihim wa-anfus hayākilihim li-yaṭmaʾinn qalbuka wa-takūn min alladhīnahum kānū fī āfāq al-qurb la-sāʾirīn.

In that station, if you were to call their first by the name of their last, or the reverse, it would be true, as the decree concerning this has descended from the Source of Divinity and the Wellspring of Lordship: “Say: Call upon God or call upon the All-Merciful; whichever you call upon, His are the most beautiful names.” For they are the manifestations of God’s name, the daysprings of His attributes, the seats of His power, and the focal points of His sovereignty. He, exalted and mighty, is in His essence sanctified above all names and transcends the ascending heights of attributes. Behold, then, the traces of God’s power in the horizons of their spirits and in their very temples, that your heart may be assured and you may be among those who journey through the horizons of nearness.

48

ثمّ اجدّد لک الکلام فی هذا المقام لیکون لک معیناً فی عرفانک بارئک فاعلم بأنّ اللّه تبارک و تعالی لن یظهر بکینونیّته و لا بذاتیّته لم یزل کان مکنوناً فی قدم ذاته و مخزوناً فی سرمدیّة کینونیّته فلمّا اراد اظهار جماله فی جبروت الأسمآء و ابراز جلاله فی ملکوت الصّفات ظهر الأنبیآء من الغیب الی الشّهود لیمتاز اسمه الظّاهر من اسمه الباطن و یظهر اسمه الأوّل عن اسمه الآخر لیکمل القول بأنّه هو الأوّل و الآخر و الظّاهر و الباطن و هو بکلّ شیء محیط و جعل مظاهر تلک الأسمآء الکبری و هذه الکلمات العلیا فی مظاهر نفسه و مرایا کینونته

Thumma ujaddid laka al-kalām fī hādhā al-maqām li-yakūn laka muʿīnan fī ʿirfānika bāriʾaka fa-ʿlam bi-anna Allāh tabāraka wa-taʿālā lan yaẓhar bi-kaynūniyyatihi wa-lā bi-dhātiyyatihi. Lam yazal kāna maknūnan fī qidam dhātihi wa-makhzūnan fī sarmadiyyat kaynūniyyatihi. Fa-lammā arāda iẓhār jamālihi fī jabarūt al-asmāʾ wa-ibrāz jalālihi fī malakūt al-ṣifāt ẓahara al-anbiyāʾ min al-ghayb ilā al-shuhūd li-yamtāz ismuhu al-Ẓāhir min ismihi al-Bāṭin wa-yaẓhar ismuhu al-Awwal ʿan ismihi al-Ākhir li-yakmul al-qawl bi-annahu huwa al-Awwal wa-l-Ākhir wa-l-Ẓāhir wa-l-Bāṭin wa-huwa bi-kull shayʾ muḥīṭ. Wa-jaʿala maẓāhir tilka al-asmāʾ al-kubrā wa-hādhihi al-kalimāt al-ʿulyā fī maẓāhir nafsihi wa-marāyā kaynūnatihi.

I will now renew My discourse to you on this station, that it may assist you in recognizing your Creator. Know that God, blessed and exalted, will never appear in His own being or His own essence. He has always remained concealed in the eternity of His essence and hidden in the everlastingness of His being. When He wished to reveal His beauty in the dominion of names and display His majesty in the kingdom of attributes, the Prophets appeared from the unseen into the visible world, that His name the Manifest might be distinguished from His name the Hidden, and His name the First might become apparent apart from His name the Last, so that the saying might be fulfilled: “He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He encompasses all things.” He placed the manifestations of those greatest names and these most exalted words within the Manifestations of His Self and the mirrors of His being.

49

اذاً ثبت بأنّ کلّ الأسمآء و الصّفات ترجع الی هذه الأنوار المقدّسة المتعالیة و تجد کلّ الأسمآء فی اسمائهم و کلّ الصّفات فی صفاتهم و فی ذلک المقام لو تدعوهم بکلّ الأسمآء لحقّ بمثل وجودهم اذاً فاعرف ما هو المقصود فی هذا البیان ثمّ اکتمها فی سرادق قلبک لتعرف حکم ما سألت و تصل الیه علی قدر ما قدّر اللّه لک لعلّ تکون من الّذینهم کانوا بمراد اللّه لمن الفائزین

Idhan thabata bi-anna kull al-asmāʾ wa-l-ṣifāt tarjiʿ ilā hādhihi al-anwār al-muqaddasa al-mutaʿāliya wa-tajid kull al-asmāʾ fī asmāʾihim wa-kull al-ṣifāt fī ṣifātihim wa-fī dhālik al-maqām law tadʿūhum bi-kull al-asmāʾ la-ḥaqq bi-mithl wujūdihim. Idhan fa-ʿrif mā huwa al-maqṣūd fī hādhā al-bayān thumma uktumhā fī surādiq qalbika li-taʿrif ḥukm mā saʾalta wa-taṣil ilayhi ʿalā qadr mā qaddara Allāh laka laʿalla takūn min alladhīnahum kānū bi-murād Allāh la-min al-fāʾizīn.

It is thus established that all names and attributes refer to these sanctified, transcendent Lights. You find all names in their names and all attributes in their attributes. In that station, if you were to call them by every name, it would be true, just as their existence is true. Recognize, then, what is intended in this exposition, and conceal it within the pavilion of your heart, that you may understand the matter about which you asked and attain it to the extent God has ordained for you. Perhaps you may be among those who attain what God intends.

50

و کلّ ما سمعت فی ذکر محمّد بن الحسن روح من فی لجج الأرواح فداه حقّ لا ریب فیه و انّا کلّ به مؤمنون ولکن ذکروا ائمّة الدّین بأنّه کان فی مدینة جابلقا و وصفوا هذه المدینة بآثار غریبة و علامات عجیبة و انّک لو ترید ان تفسّر هذه المدینة علی ظاهر الحدیث لن تقدر و لن تجدها ابداً لأنّک لو تفحّص فی اقطار العالم و اطراف البلاد لن تجدها بأوصاف الّتی وصفوها من قبل ولو تسیر فی الأرض بدوام ازلیّة اللّه و بقآء سلطنته لأنّ الأرض بتمامها لن تسعها و لن تحملها و انّک لو تدلّنی الی هذه المدینة انا ادلّک الی هذه النّفس القدسیّة الّتی عرفوه النّاس بما عندهم لا بما عنده و لمّا انت لن تقدر علی ذلک لا بدّ لک التّأویل فی هذه الأحادیث و الأخبار المرویّة عن هؤلآء الأنوار و لمّا تحتاج الی التّأویل فی هذه الحدیث المرویّة فی ذکر هذه المدینة المذکورة و کذلک تحتاج الی التّفسیر فی هذه النّفس القدمیّة و لمّا عرفت هذا التّأویل لن تحتاج الی التّبدیل و لا غیره

Wa-kull mā samiʿta fī dhikr Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan rūḥ man fī lujaj al-arwāḥ fidāhu ḥaqq lā rayb fīhi wa-innā kull bihi muʾminūn wa-lākin dhakarū aʾimmat al-dīn bi-annahu kāna fī madīnat Jābulqā wa-waṣafū hādhihi al-madīna bi-āthār gharība wa-ʿalāmāt ʿajība wa-innaka law turīd an tufassir hādhihi al-madīna ʿalā ẓāhir al-ḥadīth lan taqdir wa-lan tajidahā abadan li-annaka law tafaḥḥaṣ fī aqṭār al-ʿālam wa-aṭrāf al-bilād lan tajidahā bi-awṣāf allatī waṣafūhā min qabl wa-law tasīr fī al-arḍ bi-dawām azaliyyat Allāh wa-baqāʾ salṭanatihi li-anna al-arḍ bi-tamāmihā lan tasaʿahā wa-lan taḥmilahā. Wa-innaka law tadullunī ilā hādhihi al-madīna anā adulluka ilā hādhihi al-nafs al-qudsiyya allatī ʿarafūhu al-nās bi-mā ʿindahum lā bi-mā ʿindahu wa-lammā anta lan taqdir ʿalā dhālik lā budda laka al-taʾwīl fī hādhihi al-aḥādīth wa-l-akhbār al-marwiyya ʿan hāʾulāʾ al-anwār. Wa-lammā taḥtāj ilā al-taʾwīl fī hādhihi al-ḥadīth al-marwiyya fī dhikr hādhihi al-madīna al-madhkūra wa-kadhālika taḥtāj ilā al-tafsīr fī hādhihi al-nafs al-qidamiyya wa-lammā ʿarafta hādhā al-taʾwīl lan taḥtāj ilā al-tabdīl wa-lā ghayrihi.

Everything you have heard concerning Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may the spirit of everyone in the depths of the world of spirits be sacrificed for him—is true beyond doubt, and we all believe in it. Yet the Imams of the Faith stated that he was in the city of Jābulqā, and they described this city as having strange features and wondrous signs. If you wish to explain this city according to the outward meaning of the tradition, you will be unable to do so and will never find it. For even if you search the regions of the world and the farthest reaches of its lands, you will not find it with the characteristics they described before, even if you travel the earth for as long as God’s eternity and the permanence of His sovereignty endure. The whole earth could neither contain nor support it. If you show Me the way to this city, I will show you the way to this holy Soul, whom people have known according to what they themselves possess, not according to what he possesses. Since you cannot do that, you must interpret these traditions and reports handed down from these Lights. Just as you need interpretation for the tradition related concerning this city, so too you need an interpretation concerning this preexistent Soul. Once you understand this interpretation, you will have no need for alteration or anything else.

51

ثمّ اعلم بأنّه لمّا کان الأنبیآء کلّهم روح و نفس و اسم و رسم واحد و انّک بهذا العین لتری کلّ الظّهورات اسمهم محمّد و آبائهم حسن و ظهروا من جابلقا قدرة اللّه و یظهروا من جابلصا رحمة اللّه و جابلقا لم یکن الّا خزائن البقآء فی جبروت العمآء و مدائن الغیب فی لاهوت العلآء و نشهد بأنّ محمّد بن الحسن کان فی جابلقا و ظهر منها و من یظهره اللّه یکون فیها الی ان یظهره اللّه علی مقام سلطنته و انّا بذلک مقرّون و بکلّهم مؤمنون و انّا اختصرنا فی معانی جابلقا فی هذا المقام ولکن تعرف کلّ المعانی فی اسرار هذه الألواح لو تکون من الموقنین

Thumma iʿlam bi-annahu lammā kāna al-anbiyāʾ kulluhum rūḥ wa-nafs wa-ism wa-rasm wāḥid wa-innaka bi-hādhā al-ʿayn la-tarā kulla al-ẓuhūrāt ismuhum Muḥammad wa-ābāʾihim Ḥasan wa-ẓaharū min Jābulqā qudrat Allāh wa-yaẓharū min Jābulṣā raḥmat Allāh wa-Jābulqā lam yakun illā khazāʾin al-baqāʾ fī jabarūt al-ʿamāʾ wa-madāʾin al-ghayb fī lāhūt al-ʿalāʾ wa-nashhad bi-anna Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan kāna fī Jābulqā wa-ẓahara minhā wa-man yuẓhiruhu Allāh yakūnu fīhā ilā an yuẓhirahu Allāh ʿalā maqām salṭanatihi wa-innā bi-dhālika muqirrūn wa-bi-kullihim muʾminūn wa-innā ikhtaṣarnā fī maʿānī Jābulqā fī hādhā al-maqām wa-lākin taʿrifu kulla al-maʿānī fī asrār hādhihi al-alwāḥ law takūnu min al-mūqinīn.

Know, then, that since the Prophets are all one spirit, one soul, one name, and one designation, you will, with this eye, see that all the Manifestations bear the name Muḥammad, that their fathers are named Ḥasan, that they have appeared from the Jābulqā of God’s power, and that they appear from the Jābulṣā of God’s mercy. Jābulqā is none other than the treasuries of everlasting life in the dominion of the cloud of unknowing and the cities of the unseen in the divine realm on high. We testify that Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan was in Jābulqā and appeared from it, and that He whom God will make manifest is within it until God manifests Him in the station of His sovereignty. This we acknowledge, and in them all we believe. We have been brief concerning the meanings of Jābulqā in this passage, but you will recognize all these meanings in the mysteries of these Tablets, if you are among those who are certain.

52

ولکنّ الّذی ظهر فی السّتّین لا تحتاج فی حقّه لا التّبدیل و لا التّأویل لأنّه کان اسمه محمّد و کان من ابنآء ائمّة الدّین اذاً یصدق فی حقّه بأنّه ابن الحسن و هذا معلوم عند جنابک و مشهود لدی حضرتک بل انّه خالق الاسم و مبدعه لنفسه لو انتم بطرف اللّه تنظرون

Wa-lākinna alladhī ẓahara fī al-sittīn lā taḥtāju fī ḥaqqihi lā al-tabdīl wa-lā al-taʾwīl li-annahu kāna ismuhu Muḥammad wa-kāna min abnāʾ aʾimmat al-dīn idhan yaṣduqu fī ḥaqqihi bi-annahu ibn al-Ḥasan wa-hādhā maʿlūm ʿinda janābika wa-mashhūd ladā ḥaḍratika bal innahu khāliq al-ism wa-mubdiʿuhu li-nafsihi law antum bi-ṭarf Allāh tanẓurūn.

But concerning Him who appeared in the year sixty, you have no need of either alteration or interpretation, for His name was Muḥammad and He was a descendant of the Imams of the Faith. Thus it is true of Him that He is the son of Ḥasan. This is known to you and evident to your presence. Indeed, He is the creator of the name and its originator for Himself, if you look with the eye of God.

53

حینئذ اردنا ان نترک ما کنّا فی ذکره و اذکر ما جری علی نقطة الفرقان و نکون فیه من الذّاکرین و لتکون علی بصیرة فی کلّ الأمور من لدن عزیز جمیل

Ḥīnaʾidh aradnā an natruka mā kunnā fī dhikrihi wa-adhkura mā jarā ʿalā Nuqṭat al-Furqān wa-nakūna fīhi min al-dhākirīn wa-li-takūna ʿalā baṣīra fī kull al-umūr min ladun ʿazīz jamīl.

At this point We wish to leave what We have been discussing and recount what befell the Point of the Qur’an, becoming one of those who tell of it, so that you may gain insight into all matters from One who is mighty and beautiful.

54

فاعلم ثمّ فکّر ایّامه حین الّذی اقامه اللّه علی امره و اظهره علی مقام نفسه کیف هجموا علیه العباد و اعترضوا به و حاججوا معه و کلّما مشی قدّامهم فی المعابر و الأسواق استهزؤوا به و حرّکوا علیه رؤوسهم و سخروا به و فی کلّ حین ارادوا قتله بحیث ضاقت علیه الأرض بأوسعها و حارت فی امره سکّان ملإ الأعلی و تبدّلت ارکان البقآء بالفنآء و بکت علیه عیون اهل العمآء و اصابه من هؤلآء الکفرة الفجرة ما لا یقدر ان یسمعه اولو الوفآء

Fa-iʿlam thumma fakkir ayyāmahu ḥīna alladhī aqāmahu Allāh ʿalā amrihi wa-aẓharahu ʿalā maqām nafsihi kayfa hajamū ʿalayhi al-ʿibād wa-iʿtaraḍū bihi wa-ḥājajū maʿahu wa-kullamā mashā quddāmahum fī al-maʿābir wa-al-aswāq istahzaʾū bihi wa-ḥarrakū ʿalayhi ruʾūsahum wa-sakhirū bihi wa-fī kull ḥīn arādū qatlahu bi-ḥaythu ḍāqat ʿalayhi al-arḍ bi-awsaʿihā wa-ḥārat fī amrihi sukkān malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-tabaddalat arkān al-baqāʾ bi-al-fanāʾ wa-bakat ʿalayhi ʿuyūn ahl al-ʿamāʾ wa-aṣābahu min hāʾulāʾ al-kafara al-fajara mā lā yaqdiru an yasmaʿahu ulū al-wafāʾ.

Know, then, and reflect on His days, when God raised Him up for His Cause and manifested Him in the station of His own Self: how the people attacked Him, opposed Him, and disputed with Him. Whenever He walked before them in the streets and markets, they mocked Him, shook their heads at Him, and ridiculed Him. At every moment they sought to kill Him, until the earth, for all its vastness, became narrow for Him. The inhabitants of the Concourse on high were bewildered at His plight, the pillars of everlasting life gave way to extinction, and the eyes of the people of the cloud of unknowing wept over Him. These wicked unbelievers inflicted on Him what those who are faithful cannot bear to hear.

55

و لو انّ هؤلآء الفسقة کانوا ان یفکّروا فی امرهم و یعرفوا نغمات تلک الورقآء علی افنان هذه الشّجرة البیضآء و یرضوا بما نزّل اللّه علیهم فیما انعمهم به و یجدوا اثمار الشّجرة علی اغصانها لم اعترضوا علیه و انکروه بعد الّذی کلّهم کانوا ان یرفعوا اعناقهم لبلوغهم الیه و یسألوا اللّه فی کلّ حین بأن یشرّفهم جماله و یرزقهم لقائه

Wa-law anna hāʾulāʾ al-fasaqa kānū an yufakkirū fī amrihim wa-yaʿrifū naghamāt tilka al-warqāʾ ʿalā afnān hādhihi al-shajara al-bayḍāʾ wa-yarḍaw bi-mā nazzala Allāh ʿalayhim fīmā anʿamahum bihi wa-yajidū athmār al-shajara ʿalā aghṣānihā lam iʿtaraḍū ʿalayhi wa-ankarūhu baʿda alladhī kulluhum kānū an yarfaʿū aʿnāqahum li-bulūghihim ilayhi wa-yasʾalū Allāh fī kull ḥīn bi-an yusharrifahum jamāluhu wa-yarzuqahum liqāʾahu.

Had these evildoers reflected on their own condition, recognized the melodies of that Dove upon the boughs of this snow-white Tree, been content with what God had sent down to them among His blessings, and found the fruits of the Tree upon its branches, they would not have opposed and denied Him, after they had all stretched their necks in longing to reach Him and had asked God at every moment that His beauty might honor them and that He might grant them the bounty of meeting Him.

56

بلی لمّا ما عرفوا لحن الأحدیّة و اسرار الهویّة و اشارات القدسیّة عمّا ظهر عن لسان الأحمدیّة و ما تفکّروا فی انفسهم و اتّبعوا علمآء الباطل الّذین صدّوا عباد اللّه عن ادوار القبل و یصدّون النّاس فی اکوار البعد لذا احتجبوا عن مراد اللّه و ما شربوا عن کوثر الهویّة و صاروا محرومین عن لقآء اللّه و مظهر کینونته و مطلع ازلیّته و بذلک سلکوا فی مناهج الضّلالة و سبل الغفلة و رجعوا الی مقرّهم فی نار الّتی کانت وقودها انفسهم و کانوا فی کتاب القدس من قلم اللّه بالکفر مکتوبا و ما وجدوا و لن یجدوا الی حینئذ لأنفسهم لا من حبیب و لا من معینا

Balā lammā mā ʿarafū laḥn al-aḥadiyya wa-asrār al-huwiyya wa-ishārāt al-qudsiyya ʿammā ẓahara ʿan lisān al-Aḥmadiyya wa-mā tafakkarū fī anfusihim wa-ittabaʿū ʿulamāʾ al-bāṭil alladhīna ṣaddū ʿibād Allāh ʿan adwār al-qabl wa-yaṣuddūna al-nās fī akwār al-baʿd li-dhā iḥtajabū ʿan murād Allāh wa-mā sharibū ʿan kawthar al-huwiyya wa-ṣārū maḥrūmīn ʿan liqāʾ Allāh wa-maẓhar kaynūnatihi wa-maṭlaʿ azaliyyatihi wa-bi-dhālika salakū fī manāhij al-ḍalāla wa-subul al-ghafla wa-rajaʿū ilā maqarrihim fī nār allatī kānat waqūduhā anfusuhum wa-kānū fī kitāb al-quds min qalam Allāh bi-al-kufr maktūban wa-mā wajadū wa-lan yajidū ilā ḥīnaʾidh li-anfusihim lā min ḥabīb wa-lā min muʿīnan.

Indeed, because they did not recognize the melody of oneness, the mysteries of the divine Essence, or the intimations of holiness in what issued from the tongue of Aḥmad, and did not reflect within themselves, but followed the false divines who turned God’s servants away in former cycles and will turn people away in cycles to come, they were veiled from God’s purpose. They did not drink from the river of the divine Essence and were deprived of meeting God, the Manifestation of His being and the Dayspring of His eternity. Thus they walked the paths of error and the ways of heedlessness and returned to their abode in the fire whose fuel was their own selves. They were recorded as unbelievers by the Pen of God in the Book of Holiness, and they found no friend or helper for themselves, nor will they find one until that time.

57

و لو انّ هؤلآء یتمسّکون بنفس عروة اللّه فی قمیص المحمّدیّة و یقبلون الی اللّه بتمامهم و یلقون کلّ ما فی ایدیهم من علمائهم لیهدیهم اللّه بفضله و یعرّفهم معانی القدسیّة فی کلماته الأزلیّة لأنّ اللّه اجلّ و اعظم من ان یردّ السّائل عن بابه او یخیّب الآمل عن فنائه او یطرد من استجار فی ظلّه او یحرم من تشبّث بذیل رحمته او یبعّد فقیر الّذی نزل فی شریعة غنائه فلمّا هؤلآء ما اقبلوا الی اللّه بکلّهم و ما تشبّثوا بذیل رحمته المنبسطة فی ظهور شمس الأحدیّة خرجوا عن ظلّ الهدایة و وردوا فی مدینة الضّلالة و بذلک فسدوا و افسدوا العباد و ضلّوا و اضلّوا کلّ من فی البلاد و کانوا من الظّالمین فی کتب السّمآء مسطورا

Wa-law anna hāʾulāʾ yatamassakūna bi-nafs ʿurwat Allāh fī qamīṣ al-Muḥammadiyya wa-yuqbilūna ilā Allāh bi-tamāmihim wa-yulqūna kulla mā fī aydīhim min ʿulamāʾihim la-yahdīhim Allāh bi-faḍlihi wa-yuʿarrifuhum maʿānī al-qudsiyya fī kalimātihi al-azaliyya li-anna Allāh ajall wa-aʿẓam min an yarudda al-sāʾil ʿan bābihi aw yukhayyiba al-āmil ʿan fināʾihi aw yaṭruda man istajāra fī ẓillihi aw yaḥrima man tashabbatha bi-dhayl raḥmatihi aw yubaʿʿida faqīr alladhī nazala fī sharīʿat ghināʾihi fa-lammā hāʾulāʾ mā aqbalū ilā Allāh bi-kullihim wa-mā tashabbathū bi-dhayl raḥmatihi al-munbasiṭa fī ẓuhūr shams al-aḥadiyya kharajū ʿan ẓill al-hidāya wa-waradū fī madīnat al-ḍalāla wa-bi-dhālika fasadū wa-afsadū al-ʿibād wa-ḍallū wa-aḍallū kulla man fī al-bilād wa-kānū min al-ẓālimīn fī kutub al-samāʾ masṭūran.

Had these people held fast to the very Handle of God in the garment of Muḥammad, turned to God with their whole being, and cast aside everything they had received from their divines, God would have guided them by His grace and made known to them the holy meanings within His eternal words. For God is too exalted and too great to turn a petitioner away from His door, disappoint one who hopes at His threshold, drive away one who seeks refuge in His shade, deprive one who clings to the hem of His mercy, or banish a poor soul who has alighted at the watering place of His wealth. But because these people did not turn to God with their whole being or cling to the hem of His mercy spread abroad through the appearance of the Sun of oneness, they left the shade of guidance and entered the city of error. Thus they became corrupt and corrupted His servants, went astray and led astray everyone in the lands, and were inscribed among the wrongdoers in the books of heaven.

58

و حینئذ لمّا بلغ هذا الخادم الفانی الی هذا المقام العالی فی بیان رموز المعانی اذکر لک علّة اعتراض هؤلآء الغلاظ علی غایة الایجاز لیکون دلیلاً لأولی الألباب من اولی الأبصار و لیکون موهبة من هذا العبد علی المؤمنین جمیعاً

Wa-ḥīnaʾidh lammā balagha hādhā al-khādim al-fānī ilā hādhā al-maqām al-ʿālī fī bayān rumūz al-maʿānī adhkuru laka ʿillat iʿtirāḍ hāʾulāʾ al-ghilāẓ ʿalā ghāyat al-ījāz li-yakūna dalīlan li-ulī al-albāb min ulī al-abṣār wa-li-yakūna mawhiba min hādhā al-ʿabd ʿalā al-muʾminīn jamīʿan.

Now that this fleeting servant has reached this lofty station in explaining the allusions to these meanings, I will tell you, with the utmost brevity, the reason for the opposition of these hardhearted people, so that it may be a guide for those of understanding among those endowed with insight, and a gift from this servant to all believers.

59

فاعلم بأنّ نقطة الفرقان و نور السّبحان لمّا جآء بآیات محکمات و براهین ساطعات من الآیات الّتی تعجز عنها کلّ من فی جبروت الموجودات امر الکلّ علی القیام علی هذا الصّراط المرتفعة الممدودة فی کلّ ما جآء به من عند اللّه و من اقرّ علیه و اعترف بآیات الوحدانیّة فی فؤاده و جمال الأزلیّة فی جماله حکم علیه حکم البعث و الحشر و الحیاة و الجنّة لأنّه بعد ایمانه باللّه و مظهر جماله بعث من مرقد غفلته و حشر فی ارض فؤاده و حیّ بحیاة الایمان و الایقان و دخل فی جنّة اللّقآء هل یکن الجنّة اعلی من ذلک او الحشر اعظم من هذا او البعث اکبر من هذا البعث لو یطّلع احد بأسراره لیعرف ما لا عرف احد من العالمین

Fa-iʿlam bi-anna Nuqṭat al-Furqān wa-Nūr al-Subḥān lammā jāʾa bi-āyāt muḥkamāt wa-barāhīn sāṭiʿāt min al-āyāt allatī taʿjizu ʿanhā kull man fī jabarūt al-mawjūdāt amara al-kull ʿalā al-qiyām ʿalā hādhā al-ṣirāṭ al-murtafiʿa al-mamdūda fī kull mā jāʾa bihi min ʿind Allāh wa-man aqarra ʿalayhi wa-iʿtarafa bi-āyāt al-waḥdāniyya fī fuʾādihi wa-jamāl al-azaliyya fī jamālihi ḥakama ʿalayhi ḥukm al-baʿth wa-al-ḥashr wa-al-ḥayāt wa-al-janna li-annahu baʿda īmānihi bi-Allāh wa-maẓhar jamālihi buʿitha min marqad ghaflatihi wa-ḥushira fī arḍ fuʾādihi wa-ḥayya bi-ḥayāt al-īmān wa-al-īqān wa-dakhala fī jannat al-liqāʾ hal yakun al-janna aʿlā min dhālika aw al-ḥashr aʿẓam min hādhā aw al-baʿth akbar min hādhā al-baʿth law yaṭṭaliʿu aḥad bi-asrārihi la-yaʿrifu mā lā ʿarafa aḥad min al-ʿālamīn.

Know that when the Point of the Qur’an and the Light of the All-Glorious came with decisive verses and radiant proofs, verses that everyone in the dominion of existence is powerless to produce, He commanded all to stand firm upon this exalted path, stretched forth in everything He had brought from God. Whoever acknowledged Him and recognized the signs of oneness in His heart and the beauty of eternity in His beauty, He declared to have attained resurrection, ingathering, life, and paradise. For after believing in God and the Manifestation of His beauty, such a person was raised from the grave of heedlessness, gathered into the land of His heart, quickened with the life of faith and certitude, and admitted to the paradise of His presence. Is there any paradise higher than this, any ingathering greater than this, or any resurrection more momentous than this resurrection? Were anyone to discover its mysteries, he would know what no one among the peoples of the world has known.

60

ثمّ اعلم بأنّ هذه الجنّة فی یوم اللّه اعظم من کلّ الجنان و الطف من حقائق الرّضوان لأنّ اللّه تبارک و تعالی بعد الّذی ختم مقام النّبوّة فی شأن حبیبه و صفیّه و خیرته من خلقه کما نزل من ملکوت العزّة ولکنّه رسول اللّه و خاتم النّبیّین وعد العباد بلقائه یوم القیامة لعظمة ظهور البعد کما ظهر بالحقّ و لم یکن جنّة اعظم من ذلک و لا رتبة اکبر من هذا ان انتم فی آیات القرآن تتفکّرون فهنیئاً لمن ایقن بلقائه یوم ظهور جماله

Thumma iʿlam bi-anna hādhihi al-janna fī yawm Allāh aʿẓam min kull al-jinān wa-alṭaf min ḥaqāʾiq al-riḍwān li-anna Allāh tabāraka wa-taʿālā baʿda alladhī khatama maqām al-nubuwwa fī shaʾn ḥabībihi wa-ṣafiyyihi wa-khīratihi min khalqihi kamā nazala min malakūt al-ʿizza wa-lākinnahu rasūl Allāh wa-khātam al-nabiyyīn waʿada al-ʿibād bi-liqāʾihi yawm al-qiyāma li-ʿaẓamat ẓuhūr al-baʿd kamā ẓahara bi-al-ḥaqq wa-lam yakun janna aʿẓam min dhālika wa-lā rutba akbar min hādhā in antum fī āyāt al-Qurʾān tatafakkarūn fa-hanīʾan li-man ayqana bi-liqāʾihi yawm ẓuhūr jamālihi.

Know, moreover, that this paradise in the Day of God is greater than all paradises and more sublime than the realities of Riḍwān. For God, blessed and exalted is He, after sealing the station of prophethood in His Beloved, His chosen One, the One He selected from among His creation—as was sent down from the kingdom of glory, “But He is the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets”—promised His servants that they would meet Him on the Day of Resurrection, because of the greatness of the subsequent Revelation, as has indeed come to pass. There is no paradise greater than this and no rank higher than this, if you reflect on the verses of the Qur’an. Blessed, then, is the one who is certain of meeting Him on the day His beauty is revealed.

61

و انّی لو اذکر لک آیات النّازلة فی هذه الرّتبة العالیة لیطول الکلام و تبعد عن المرام ولکن اذکر هذه الآیة و نکتفی بها لتقرّ عیناک و تصل الی ما کنز فیها و خزن بها و هی هذه اللّه الّذی رفع السّموات بغیر عمد ترونها ثمّ استوی علی العرش و سخّر الشّمس و القمر کلّ یجری لأجل مسمّی یدبّر الأمر یفصّل الآیات لعلّکم بلقآء ربّکم توقنون

Wa-innī law adhkuru laka āyāt al-nāzila fī hādhihi al-rutba al-ʿāliya la-yaṭūlu al-kalām wa-tabʿudu ʿan al-marām wa-lākin adhkuru hādhihi al-āya wa-naktafī bihā li-taqarra ʿaynāka wa-taṣila ilā mā kuniza fīhā wa-khuzina bihā wa-hiya hādhihi Allāh alladhī rafaʿa al-samāwāt bi-ghayr ʿamad tarawnahā thumma istawā ʿalā al-ʿarsh wa-sakhkhara al-shams wa-al-qamar kull yajrī li-ajal musamman yudabbiru al-amr yufaṣṣilu al-āyāt laʿallakum bi-liqāʾ rabbikum tūqinūn.

Were I to recount for you the verses sent down concerning this lofty rank, the discourse would grow long and you would be drawn away from the purpose. But I will mention this verse, and We will content Ourselves with it, so that your eyes may be gladdened and you may attain what is treasured and stored within it. It is this: “God is He who raised the heavens without pillars that you can see, then established Himself upon the throne and subjected the sun and the moon, each running its course for an appointed term. He directs all affairs and sets out the signs, so that you may be certain of meeting your Lord.”

62

اذاً فالتفت یا حبیبی فی ذکر الایقان فی هذه الآیة کأنّ السّموات و الأرض و العرش و الشّمس و القمر کلّهنّ خلقن لایقان العباد لقائه فی ایّامه فواللّه یا اخی فانظر عظمة هذا المقام و شأن هؤلآء العباد فی هذه الأیّام کأنّهم حمر مستنفرة فرّت عن طلعة الالهیّة و جمال الهویّة لو تفکّر فیما نزّلناک لتجد ما اردنا فی ذکر هذا البیان و تعرف ما احببنا ان نعلّمک فی هذا الرّضوان لتقرّ عیناک عن النّظر فیها و تلذّ سمعک عن استماع ما قرئ فیها و تحظّ نفسک عن ادراکها و ینوّر قلبک عن عرفانها و تستبشر روحک عن عطر الّذی نفح منها و تصل الی غایة فیض اللّه و تکون فی رضوان القدس لمن الخالدین

Idhan fa-iltafit yā ḥabībī fī dhikr al-īqān fī hādhihi al-āya ka-anna al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ wa-al-ʿarsh wa-al-shams wa-al-qamar kullahunna khuliqna li-īqān al-ʿibād liqāʾahu fī ayyāmihi fa-wa-Allāh yā akhī fa-unẓur ʿaẓamat hādhā al-maqām wa-shaʾn hāʾulāʾ al-ʿibād fī hādhihi al-ayyām ka-annahum ḥumur mustanfira farrat ʿan ṭalʿat al-ilāhiyya wa-jamāl al-huwiyya law tufakkir fīmā nazzalnāka la-tajidu mā aradnā fī dhikr hādhā al-bayān wa-taʿrifu mā aḥbabnā an nuʿallimaka fī hādhā al-riḍwān li-taqarra ʿaynāka ʿan al-naẓar fīhā wa-taladhdha samʿuka ʿan istimāʿ mā quriʾa fīhā wa-taḥuẓẓa nafsuka ʿan idrākihā wa-yunawwara qalbuka ʿan ʿirfānihā wa-tastabshira rūḥuka ʿan ʿiṭr alladhī nafaḥa minhā wa-taṣila ilā ghāyat fayḍ Allāh wa-takūna fī riḍwān al-quds la-min al-khālidīn.

Consider, then, My beloved, the mention of certitude in this verse. It is as though the heavens, the earth, the throne, the sun, and the moon were all created so that His servants might be certain of meeting Him in His days. By God, My brother! Look at the greatness of this station and the condition of these servants in these days: they are like startled asses fleeing from the divine Countenance and the beauty of the divine Essence. If you reflect on what We have sent down to you, you will discover Our purpose in this utterance and recognize what We have desired to teach you in this garden, so that your eyes may be gladdened by gazing upon it, your hearing delighted by listening to what is recited within it, your soul enriched by comprehending it, your heart illumined by recognizing it, and your spirit rejoiced by the fragrance wafting from it; that you may attain the utmost outpouring of God’s grace and be among those who dwell forever in the garden of holiness.

63

و من اعرض عن اللّه فی حقّه و ادبر و طغی ثمّ کفر و شقی حکم علیه حکم الشّرک و الکفر و الموت و النّار و ایّ شرک اعظم من اقباله الی مظاهر الشّیطان و اتّباعه علمآء النّسیان و اصحاب الطّغیان و ایّ کفر اعلی عن اعراضه عن اللّه فی یوم الّذی یجدّد فیه الایمان من اللّه المقتدر المنّان و ایّ موت اذلّ عن فراره عن منبع الحیّ الحیوان و ایّ نار احرّ عن بعده عن جمال الهویّة و جلال الأحدیّة فی یوم التّغابن و الاحسان

Wa-man aʿraḍa ʿan Allāh fī ḥaqqihi wa-adbara wa-ṭaghā thumma kafara wa-shaqiya ḥakama ʿalayhi ḥukm al-shirk wa-al-kufr wa-al-mawt wa-al-nār wa-ayy shirk aʿẓam min iqbālihi ilā maẓāhir al-shayṭān wa-ittibāʿihi ʿulamāʾ al-nisyān wa-aṣḥāb al-ṭughyān wa-ayy kufr aʿlā ʿan iʿrāḍihi ʿan Allāh fī yawm alladhī yujaddadu fīhi al-īmān min Allāh al-muqtadir al-mannān wa-ayy mawt adhall ʿan firārihi ʿan manbaʿ al-ḥayy al-ḥayawān wa-ayy nār aḥarr ʿan buʿdihi ʿan jamāl al-huwiyya wa-jalāl al-aḥadiyya fī yawm al-taghābun wa-al-iḥsān.

But whoever turned away from God in His person, withdrew and rebelled, then disbelieved and fell into misery, He pronounced upon him the judgment of idolatry, unbelief, death, and fire. What idolatry is greater than turning to the manifestations of Satan and following the divines of forgetfulness and the companions of rebellion? What unbelief is greater than turning away from God on the day when faith is renewed by God, the All-Powerful, the All-Bountiful? What death is more abject than fleeing from the Source of the Ever-Living, the One who is Life itself? What fire is hotter than remoteness from the beauty of the divine Essence and the majesty of oneness on the day of loss and beneficence?

64

و انّ اعراب الجاهلیّة بهذه العبارات و الکلمات اعترضوا علیه و حکموا علیه ما حکموا و قالوا هؤلآء الّذین آمنوا بمحمّد هم کانوا معنا و راودونا فی کلّ لیل و نهار متی ماتوا و بأیّ یوم رجعوا فاسمع ما نزل فیما قالوا ان تعجب فعجب قولهم ائذا کنّا تراباً و عظاماً ائنّا لمبعوثون و فی مقام اخری و لئن قلت انّکم مبعوثون من بعد الموت لیقولنّ الّذین کفروا ان هذا الّا سحر مبین و بذلک استهزؤوا به و سخروا علیه لأنّهم شهدوا فی کتبهم و سمعوا من علمائهم لفظ الموت و الحیاة و فسّروهما بالموت الظّاهریّة و الحیاة العنصریّة فلمّا ما وجدوا ما عرفوا من ظنونهم المجتثّة و عقولهم الافکیّة الخبیثة رفعوا اعلام الاختلاف و رایات الفساد و اشتعلوا نار الحرب ولو اطفأها اللّه بقدرته کما تشهد الیوم من هؤلآء المشرکین و هؤلآء الفاسقین

Wa-inna aʿrāb al-jāhiliyya bi-hādhihi al-ʿibārāt wa-al-kalimāt iʿtaraḍū ʿalayhi wa-ḥakamū ʿalayhi mā ḥakamū wa-qālū hāʾulāʾ alladhīna āmanū bi-Muḥammad hum kānū maʿanā wa-rāwadūnā fī kull layl wa-nahār matā mātū wa-bi-ayy yawm rajaʿū fa-ismaʿ mā nazala fīmā qālū in taʿjab fa-ʿajab qawluhum a-idhā kunnā turāban wa-ʿiẓāman a-innā la-mabʿūthūn wa-fī maqām ukhrā wa-la-in qulta innakum mabʿūthūn min baʿd al-mawt la-yaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥr mubīn wa-bi-dhālika istahzaʾū bihi wa-sakhirū ʿalayhi li-annahum shahidū fī kutubihim wa-samiʿū min ʿulamāʾihim lafẓ al-mawt wa-al-ḥayāt wa-fassarūhumā bi-al-mawt al-ẓāhiriyya wa-al-ḥayāt al-ʿunṣuriyya fa-lammā mā wajadū mā ʿarafū min ẓunūnihim al-mujtaththa wa-ʿuqūlihim al-ifkiyya al-khabītha rafaʿū aʿlām al-ikhtilāf wa-rāyāt al-fasād wa-ishtaʿalū nār al-ḥarb wa-law aṭfaʾahā Allāh bi-qudratihi kamā tashhadu al-yawm min hāʾulāʾ al-mushrikīn wa-hāʾulāʾ al-fāsiqīn.

The Arabs of the age of ignorance objected to Him on account of these expressions and words, passed the judgments against Him that they did, and said, “These people who have believed in Muḥammad were with us and associated with us every night and day. When did they die, and on what day did they return?” Listen, then, to what was sent down concerning what they said: “If you marvel, marvelous indeed is their saying, ‘When we have become dust and bones, will we truly be raised up?’” And in another passage: “If you say, ‘You will surely be raised up after death,’ those who disbelieve will say, ‘This is nothing but manifest sorcery.’” Thus they mocked and ridiculed Him, for they had seen the words “death” and “life” in their books and heard them from their divines, and had interpreted them as outward death and bodily life. When they did not find what they had understood through their groundless suppositions and their lying, malicious minds, they raised the standards of discord and the banners of corruption and kindled the fire of war, even though God extinguished it through His power, just as you witness today from these idolaters and these evildoers.

65

و انّی حینئذ لمّا هبّت علیّ رائحة الجذب عن مدینة البقآء و احاطتنی غلبات الشّوق من شطر الاشراق فیما لاحت شمس الآفاق من رکن العراق و اسمعنی نغمات الحجاز فی اسرار الفراق ارید ان اذکر لجنابک بعض ما غنّت الورقآء فی قطب العمآء فی معنی الحیاة و الموت ولو انّ هذا ممتنع لأنّی لو ارید ان افسّر لک کما هو المکتوب فی الواح المحفوظ لن تحمله الأرواح و لن تسعه الأوراق و لن تطیقه الأرواح ولکن اذکر علی ما ینبغی لهذا الزّمان و هذه الأوان لیکون دلیلاً لمن اراد ان یدخل فی رفرف المعانی و یسمع نغمات الرّوحانی من هذا الطّیر المعنویّ الالهی و یکون من الّذینهم انقطعوا الی اللّه و کانوا الیوم بلقآء اللّه یستبشرون

Wa-innī ḥīnaʾidhin lammā habbat ʿalayya rāʾiḥat al-jadhb ʿan madīnat al-baqāʾ wa-aḥāṭatnī ghalabāt al-shawq min shaṭr al-ishrāq fīmā lāḥat shams al-āfāq min rukn al-ʿIrāq wa-asmaʿanī naghamāt al-Ḥijāz fī asrār al-firāq urīdu an adhkura li-janābika baʿḍa mā ghannat al-Warqāʾ fī quṭb al-ʿamāʾ fī maʿnā al-ḥayāt wa-al-mawt wa-law anna hādhā mumtaniʿ li-annī law urīdu an ufassira laka kamā huwa al-maktūb fī alwāḥ al-maḥfūẓ lan taḥmilahu al-arwāḥ wa-lan tasaʿahu al-awrāq wa-lan tuṭīqahu al-arwāḥ wa-lākin adhkuru ʿalā mā yanbaghī li-hādhā al-zamān wa-hādhihi al-awān li-yakūna dalīlan li-man arāda an yadkhula fī rafraf al-maʿānī wa-yasmaʿa naghamāt al-rūḥānī min hādhā al-ṭayr al-maʿnawiyy al-ilāhī wa-yakūna min alladhīnahum inqaṭaʿū ilā Allāh wa-kānū al-yawm bi-liqāʾ Allāh yastabshirūn.

Now that the fragrance of rapture has wafted over Me from the city of eternity, and the surging forces of longing have surrounded Me from the direction of the dawning light, as the Sun of the horizons has shone from the region of Iraq and caused Me to hear the melodies of the Hijaz concerning the mysteries of separation, I wish to mention to you something of what the Dove has sung at the heart of the cloud of unknowing concerning the meaning of life and death. Yet this is impossible, for if I wished to explain it to you as it is written in the Preserved Tablets, spirits could not bear it, pages could not contain it, and souls could not endure it. Nevertheless, I will speak as befits this time and this hour, that it may be a guide for anyone who wishes to enter the pavilion of meanings, hear spiritual melodies from this divine, spiritual Bird, and be among those who have detached themselves from all but God and rejoice today in meeting Him.

66

فاعرف بأنّ للحیاة مقامین مقام یتعلّق بظاهر البشریّة فی جسد العنصریّة و هذا معلوم عند جنابک و عند کلّ من علی الأرض بمثل الشّمس فی وسط السّمآء و هذه الحیاة تفنی من موت الظّاهریّة و هذا حقّ من عند اللّه و لا مفرّ لأحد و امّا الحیاة الّتی هی المذکور فی کتب الأنبیآء و الأولیآء لم [یکن] الّا الحیاة العرفانیّة ای عرفان العبد آیة تجلّی مجلّیه بما تجلّی له به بنفسه و ایقانه بلقآء اللّه فی مظاهر امره و هذه هی الحیاة الطّیّبة الباقیة الدّائمة الّتی من یحیی به لن یموت ابداً و یکون باقیاً ببقآء ربّه و دائماً بدوام بارئه

Fa-iʿraf bi-anna li-al-ḥayāt maqāmayn maqām yataʿallaqu bi-ẓāhir al-bashariyya fī jasad al-ʿunṣuriyya wa-hādhā maʿlūm ʿinda janābika wa-ʿinda kull man ʿalā al-arḍ bi-mithl al-shams fī wasaṭ al-samāʾ wa-hādhihi al-ḥayāt tafnā min mawt al-ẓāhiriyya wa-hādhā ḥaqq min ʿind Allāh wa-lā mafarra li-aḥad wa-ammā al-ḥayāt allatī hiya al-madhkūr fī kutub al-anbiyāʾ wa-al-awliyāʾ lam [yakun] illā al-ḥayāt al-ʿirfāniyya ay ʿirfān al-ʿabd āyat tajallī mujallīhi bi-mā tajallā lahu bihi bi-nafsihi wa-īqānihi bi-liqāʾ Allāh fī maẓāhir amrihi wa-hādhihi hiya al-ḥayāt al-ṭayyiba al-bāqiya al-dāʾima allatī man yaḥyā bihi lan yamūta abadan wa-yakūnu bāqiyan bi-baqāʾ rabbihi wa-dāʾiman bi-dawām bāriʾihi.

Know that life has two stations. One concerns the outward human condition in the elemental body. This is as well known to you and to everyone on earth as the sun in the middle of the sky. This life ends with outward death. This is a truth from God, and no one can escape it. But the life mentioned in the books of the Prophets and the holy ones is nothing other than the life of spiritual recognition: the servant’s recognition of the sign of the revelation of the One who reveals Himself to him, through that by which He has revealed Himself to him in His own person, and his certainty of meeting God in the Manifestations of His Cause. This is the good, abiding, everlasting life. Whoever lives through it will never die, but will abide through the abiding of his Lord and endure through the endurance of his Creator.

67

و الحیاة الأوّلیّة الّتی کانت متعلّقة بالجسد العنصریّة ینفد بما نزل من عند اللّه کلّ نفس ذائقة الموت و الحیاة الثّانویّة الّتی کانت من المعرفة ما تنفد کما نزل من قبل فلنحیینّه حیاة طیّبة و فی مقام اخری فی ذکر الشّهدآء بل احیآء عند ربّهم یرزقون و ما ورد فی الأخبار المؤمن حیّ فی الدّارین و بمثل تلک الکلمات کثیر فی کتب اللّه و مظاهر عدله و انّا ما اردنا ذکرها للاختصار و اکتفینا بذلک فیما اردنا لک

Wa-al-ḥayāt al-awwaliyya allatī kānat mutaʿalliqa bi-al-jasad al-ʿunṣuriyya yanfadu bi-mā nazala min ʿind Allāh kull nafs dhāʾiqat al-mawt wa-al-ḥayāt al-thānawiyya allatī kānat min al-maʿrifa mā tanfadu kamā nazala min qabl fa-la-nuḥyiyannahu ḥayātan ṭayyiba wa-fī maqām ukhrā fī dhikr al-shuhadāʾ bal aḥyāʾ ʿinda rabbihim yurzaqūn wa-mā warada fī al-akhbār al-muʾmin ḥayy fī al-dārayn wa-bi-mithl tilka al-kalimāt kathīr fī kutub Allāh wa-maẓāhir ʿadlihi wa-innā mā aradnā dhikrahā li-al-ikhtiṣār wa-iktafaynā bi-dhālika fīmā aradnā laka.

The first life, which is connected with the elemental body, comes to an end, in accordance with what has been sent down from God: “Every soul will taste death.” But the second life, which comes from spiritual knowledge, does not come to an end, as was sent down before: “We will surely grant him a good life,” and, in another passage concerning the martyrs: “Rather, they are alive, sustained in the presence of their Lord.” It is also related in the traditions: “The believer is alive in both worlds.” Many such words are found in the books of God and the Manifestations of His justice. For brevity, We have not wished to mention them, and have contented Ourselves with this for what We intended for you.

68

اذاً یا اخی فأعرض عن هواک ثمّ اقبل الی مولاک و لا تتّبع الّذین کان الههم هواهم لتدخل فی قطب الحیاة فی ظلّ النّجاة من مربّی الأسمآء و الصّفات لأنّ الّذینهم الیوم اعرضوا عن ربّهم اموات ولو یمشون علی الأرض و صمّآء ولو یسمعون و عمیآء ولو یشهدون کما صرّح بذلک مالک یوم الدّین و لهم قلوب لا یفقهون بها و لهم اعین لا یبصرون بها الی آخر القول بل انّهم یمشون علی شفا جرف هار او فی شفا حفرة من النّار لم یکن لهم نصیب من هذا البحر المتموّج الذّخّار و کانوا فی زخارف اقوالهم یلعبون

Idhan yā akhī fa-aʿriḍ ʿan hawāka thumma aqbil ilā mawlāka wa-lā tattabiʿ alladhīna kāna ilāhuhum hawāhum li-tadkhula fī quṭb al-ḥayāt fī ẓill al-najāt min murabbī al-asmāʾ wa-al-ṣifāt li-anna alladhīnahum al-yawm aʿraḍū ʿan rabbihim amwāt wa-law yamshūna ʿalā al-arḍ wa-ṣummāʾ wa-law yasmaʿūn wa-ʿumyāʾ wa-law yashhadūn kamā ṣarraḥa bi-dhālika mālik yawm al-dīn wa-lahum qulūb lā yafqahūna bihā wa-lahum aʿyun lā yubṣirūna bihā ilā ākhir al-qawl bal innahum yamshūna ʿalā shafā juruf hār aw fī shafā ḥufra min al-nār lam yakun lahum naṣīb min hādhā al-baḥr al-mutamawwij al-dhakhkhār wa-kānū fī zakhārif aqwālihim yalʿabūn.

Then, My brother, turn away from your desires and turn toward your Master. Do not follow those who have made their desires their god, so that you may enter the heart of life beneath the shelter of salvation granted by the Nurturer of names and attributes. For those who have turned away from their Lord today are dead, even though they walk the earth; deaf, even though they hear; and blind, even though they see. The Master of the Day of Judgment has explicitly declared this: “They have hearts with which they do not understand, and eyes with which they do not see,” and so on to the end of the passage. Indeed, they walk along the edge of a crumbling bank, or on the brink of a pit of fire. They have no share of this surging, overflowing ocean, and amuse themselves with the embellishments of their own words.

69

و حینئذ نلقی علیک فی هذا المقام فی ذکر الحیاة ما نزّل من قبل لیقلّبک عن اشارات النّفس و یخلّصک عن ضیق القفس فی هذا الجوار الخنّس و تکون فی ظلمات الأرض لمن المهتدین

Wa-ḥīnaʾidhin nulqī ʿalayka fī hādhā al-maqām fī dhikr al-ḥayāt mā nuzzila min qabl li-yuqallibaka ʿan ishārāt al-nafs wa-yukhalliṣaka ʿan ḍīq al-qafaṣ fī hādhā al-jawār al-khunnas wa-takūna fī ẓulumāt al-arḍ la-min al-muhtadīn.

Now, in this connection, We convey to you what was sent down before concerning life, so that it may turn you away from the promptings of the self, free you from the confines of the cage amid these coursing, receding stars, and make you one of those who are guided through the darkness of the earth.

70

قال و قوله الحقّ او من کان میتاً فأحییناه و جعلنا له نوراً یمشی به فی النّاس کمن مثله فی الظّلمات لیس بخارج منها هذه الآیة نزلت فی شأن الحمزة و ابوجهل لمّا آمن الأوّل و کفر الثّانی و بذلک استهزؤوا اکثر العلمآء من علمآء الجاهلیّة و تبلبلوا و تهزّلوا و تصاحوا و قالوا کیف مات الحمزة و کیف رجع الی حیاة الأولی و بمثل ذلک کثیر فی الکتاب لو انتم فی آیات اللّه تتفرّسون

Qāla wa-qawluhu al-ḥaqq a-wa-man kāna maytan fa-aḥyaynāhu wa-jaʿalnā lahu nūran yamshī bihi fī al-nās ka-man mathaluhu fī al-ẓulumāt laysa bi-khārij minhā hādhihi al-āya nazalat fī shaʾn al-Ḥamza wa-Abū Jahl lammā āmana al-awwal wa-kafara al-thānī wa-bi-dhālika istahzaʾū akthar al-ʿulamāʾ min ʿulamāʾ al-jāhiliyya wa-tabalbalū wa-tahazzalū wa-taṣāḥū wa-qālū kayfa māta al-Ḥamza wa-kayfa rajaʿa ilā ḥayāt al-ūlā wa-bi-mithl dhālika kathīr fī al-kitāb law antum fī āyāt Allāh tatafarrasūn.

He said—and His word is the truth—“Is someone who was dead, whom We brought to life and for whom We made a light by which he walks among people, like someone who is in darkness and cannot emerge from it?” This verse was sent down concerning Ḥamza and Abū Jahl, when the former believed and the latter disbelieved. Most of the divines of the age of ignorance mocked at this, became confused, made jests, and cried out, saying, “How did Ḥamza die, and how did he return to his former life?” There is much like this in the Book, if you examine the verses of God discerningly.

71

فیا لیت وجدت قلوباً صافیةً لألقی علیهم رشحاً من ابحر العلم الّذی علّمنی ربّی لیطیرنّ فی الهوآء کما یمشون علی الأرض و یرکضنّ علی المآء کما یرکضون علی التّراب و یأخذوا ارواحهم بأیدیهم و یفدوها فی سبیل بارئهم ولکن ما جآء الاذن علی القضآء فی هذا الرّمز العظمی و لم یزل کان هذا السّرّ مخزوناً فی کنوز القدرة و هذا الرّمز مکنوناً فی خزائن القوّة لئلّا یهلکون العباد انفسهم رجآء لهذا المقام الأعظم فی ممالک القدم و لن یصله الّذین یمشون فی ظلمات الصّیلم المظلم

Fa-yā layta wajadtu qulūban ṣāfiya li-ulqiya ʿalayhim rashḥan min abḥur al-ʿilm alladhī ʿallamanī rabbī li-yaṭīranna fī al-hawāʾ kamā yamshūna ʿalā al-arḍ wa-yarkuḍanna ʿalā al-māʾ kamā yarkuḍūna ʿalā al-turāb wa-yaʾkhudhū arwāḥahum bi-aydīhim wa-yafdūhā fī sabīl bāriʾihim wa-lākin mā jāʾa al-idhn ʿalā al-qaḍāʾ fī hādhā al-ramz al-ʿuẓmā wa-lam yazal kāna hādhā al-sirr makhzūnan fī kunūz al-qudra wa-hādhā al-ramz maknūnan fī khazāʾin al-quwwa li-allā yuhlikūna al-ʿibād anfusahum rajāʾan li-hādhā al-maqām al-aʿẓam fī mamālik al-qidam wa-lan yaṣilahu alladhīna yamshūna fī ẓulumāt al-ṣaylam al-muẓlim.

If only I could find pure hearts, that I might cast upon them a sprinkling from the oceans of the knowledge My Lord has taught Me, so that they might fly through the air as they walk upon the earth, run upon water as they run upon the dust, take their souls in their hands, and sacrifice them in the path of their Creator. But permission has not been given to pronounce upon this supreme mystery. This secret has always been stored in the treasuries of power, and this mystery concealed in the repositories of might, lest the servants destroy themselves in the hope of attaining this most great station in the realms of eternity. Those who walk in the darkness of blackest night will never attain it.

72

و لقد کرّرنا القول یا اخی فی کلّ المقام لیوضح لک باذن اللّه کلّ الأمور عمّا سطر فی السّطور و لیغنیک عن الّذینهم یخوضون فی انفس الدّیجور و یمشون فی وادی الکبر و الغرور و لتکون فی فردوس الحیّ الحیوان لمن السّائرین

Wa-la-qad karrarnā al-qawl yā akhī fī kull al-maqām li-yūḍiḥa laka bi-idhn Allāh kull al-umūr ʿammā suṭira fī al-suṭūr wa-li-yughniyaka ʿan alladhīnahum yakhūḍūna fī anfas al-dayjūr wa-yamshūna fī wādī al-kibr wa-al-ghurūr wa-li-takūna fī firdaws al-Ḥayy al-Ḥayawān la-min al-sāʾirīn.

My brother, We have repeated Our words at every point so that, by God’s permission, everything set down in these lines may become clear to you, that you may have no need of those who plunge into the depths of darkness and walk in the valley of pride and delusion, and that you may be among those who journey in the paradise of the Ever-Living, the One who is Life itself.

73

قل یا اهل الملإ [الظّنّ] انّ شجرة الحیاة قد غرست فی وسط فردوس اللّه و یعطی الحیاة عن کلّ الجهات کیف انتم لا تشعرون و لا تعرفون و یؤیّدک فی کلّ ما القیناک من جواهر اسرار الهویّة من هذا النّفس المطمئنّة تغنّی حمامة القدس فی فردوس البقآء و اذکر لک لتلبس قمیص الجدید من زبر الحدید لیحفظک عن رمی الشّبهات فی تلک الاشارات و هی هذه انّ من لم یلد من المآء و الرّوح لن یقدر ان یدخل ملکوت اللّه لأنّ المولود من الجسد جسد هو و المولود من الرّوح فهو روح فلا تتعجّبنّ من قولی انّه ینبغی لکم ان تولدوا مرّة اخری

Qul yā ahl al-malaʾ [al-ẓann] inna shajarat al-ḥayāt qad ghurisat fī wasaṭ firdaws Allāh wa-yuʿṭī al-ḥayāt ʿan kull al-jihāt kayfa antum lā tashʿurūn wa-lā taʿrifūn wa-yuʾayyiduka fī kull mā alqaynāka min jawāhir asrār al-huwiyya min hādhā al-nafs al-muṭmaʾinna taghannī Ḥamāmat al-Quds fī firdaws al-baqāʾ wa-adhkuru laka li-talbasa qamīṣ al-jadīd min zubar al-ḥadīd li-yaḥfaẓaka ʿan ramy al-shubuhāt fī tilka al-ishārāt wa-hiya hādhihi inna man lam yalid min al-māʾ wa-al-rūḥ lan yaqdira an yadkhula malakūt Allāh li-anna al-mawlūd min al-jasad jasad huwa wa-al-mawlūd min al-rūḥ fa-huwa rūḥ fa-lā tataʿajjabanna min qawlī innahu yanbaghī lakum an tūladū marratan ukhrā.

Say: People of the assembly of [conjecture]! The Tree of Life has been planted in the midst of God’s paradise and bestows life in every direction. How is it that you neither perceive nor recognize it? The song of the Dove of Holiness in the paradise of eternity confirms for you all the jewels of the mysteries of the divine Essence that We have conveyed to you from this assured Soul. I will recount it to you so that you may put on a new garment made of blocks of iron, to protect you against the doubts hurled at those allusions. It is this: “Whoever is not born of water and the Spirit cannot enter the Kingdom of God, for what is born of the flesh is flesh, and what is born of the Spirit is spirit. So do not marvel at My saying that you must be born again.”

74

اذاً طیّر الی شجر الالهی و خذ من ثمراتها ثمّ القط عمّا سقط عنها و کن لها حافظاً امین و فکّر فیما ذکر واحد من الأنبیآء حین الّذی یبشّر الأرواح بمن یأتی بعده باشارات مقنّعة و رموزات مغطّئة من دون الجهر من القول لتوقن بأن لا یعرف کلماتهم الّا اولو الألباب الی ان قال کانت عینتاه کلهیب النّار و کانت رجلاه کالنّحاس و کان یخرج من فمه سیف ذا فمین حینئذ کیف یفسّر هذه الکلمات و فی الظّاهر لو یجیء احد بتلک العلامات لم یکن بانسان و کیف یستأنس به احد بل لمّا یظهر فی مدینة تفرّون منه اهل مدینة اخری و لا یقربوا به احد ابداً مع انّک لو تفکّر فی هذه العبارات لتجدها علی غایة الفصاحة و نهایة البلاغة بحیث عرجت الی غایة البیان و وصلت الی منتهی مقام التّبیان کأنّ شموس البلاغة منها ظهرت و انجم الفصاحة عنها بزغت و لاحت

Idhan ṭayyir ilā shajar al-ilāhī wa-khudh min thamarātihā thumma ilquṭ ʿammā saqaṭa ʿanhā wa-kun lahā ḥāfiẓan amīn wa-fakkir fīmā dhakara wāḥid min al-anbiyāʾ ḥīna alladhī yubashshiru al-arwāḥ bi-man yaʾtī baʿdahu bi-ishārāt muqannaʿa wa-rumūzāt mughaṭṭaʾa min dūn al-jahr min al-qawl li-tūqina bi-an lā yaʿrif kalimātihim illā ulū al-albāb ilā an qāla kānat ʿaynatāhu ka-lahīb al-nār wa-kānat rijlāhu ka-al-nuḥās wa-kāna yakhruju min famihi sayf dhā famayn ḥīnaʾidhin kayfa yufassiru hādhihi al-kalimāt wa-fī al-ẓāhir law yajīʾu aḥad bi-tilka al-ʿalāmāt lam yakun bi-insān wa-kayfa yastaʾnisu bihi aḥad bal lammā yaẓharu fī madīna tafirrūna minhu ahl madīna ukhrā wa-lā yaqrabū bihi aḥad abadan maʿa annaka law tufakkir fī hādhihi al-ʿibārāt la-tajiduhā ʿalā ghāyat al-faṣāḥa wa-nihāyat al-balāgha bi-ḥayth ʿarajat ilā ghāyat al-bayān wa-waṣalat ilā muntahā maqām al-tibyān ka-anna shumūs al-balāgha minhā ẓaharat wa-anjum al-faṣāḥa ʿanhā bazaghat wa-lāḥat.

Then fly to the divine Tree, take of its fruits, gather what has fallen from it, and be its faithful guardian. Reflect on what one of the Prophets said when he gave souls the glad tidings of the One who would come after him through veiled allusions and concealed symbols, rather than speaking openly, so that you may be certain that none but those endowed with understanding recognize their words. He went on to say: “His eyes were like a flame of fire, His feet were like brass, and from His mouth came a two-edged sword.” How, then, are these words to be interpreted? If someone were to appear with these signs in their outward sense, he would not be a human being, and how could anyone feel at ease with him? Indeed, when he appeared in one city, you, the people of another city, would flee from him, and no one would ever approach him. Yet if you reflect on these expressions, you will find them supremely eloquent and consummately expressive, having ascended to the summit of utterance and reached the utmost station of exposition. It is as though the suns of eloquence have appeared from them and the stars of lucid speech have risen and shone from them.

75

اذاً فاعرف هؤلآء الحمرآء من امم الماضیة و الّذین یکونون فی تلک الأیّام ینتظرون مجیء تلک الانسان و لو لا تجیء هذه النّفس علی هذه الصّورة المذکورة لن یؤمنوا به ابداً و لمّا ما یجیء هذه ابداً انّهم لن یؤمنوا ابداً هذا مبلغ هؤلآء الکفرة من انفس المشرکة و انّ الّذین ما یعرفون ما هو ابده البدیهیّات و اظهر الظّاهریّات فکیف یعرفون غوامض اصول الالهیّة و جواهر اسرار حکمة الصّمدانیّة

Idhan fa-iʿraf hāʾulāʾ al-ḥamrāʾ min umam al-māḍiya wa-alladhīna yakūnūna fī tilka al-ayyām yantaẓirūna majīʾ tilka al-insān wa-law lā tajīʾu hādhihi al-nafs ʿalā hādhihi al-ṣūra al-madhkūra lan yuʾminū bihi abadan wa-lammā mā yajīʾu hādhihi abadan innahum lan yuʾminū abadan hādhā mablagh hāʾulāʾ al-kafara min anfus al-mushrika wa-inna alladhīna mā yaʿrifūna mā huwa abdah al-badīhiyyāt wa-aẓhar al-ẓāhiriyyāt fa-kayfa yaʿrifūna ghawāmiḍ uṣūl al-ilāhiyya wa-jawāhir asrār ḥikmat al-ṣamadāniyya.

Then recognize these foolish ones among the peoples of the past, and those who in these days await the coming of that Man. Unless this Soul comes in the form described, they will never believe in Him; and since He will never come in this way, they will never believe. Such is the extent of the understanding of these unbelieving, idolatrous souls. How can those who do not recognize the most self-evident of truths and the most manifest of things recognize the subtleties of the divine principles and the jewels of the mysteries of the wisdom of the Eternal?

76

و انّی حینئذ افسّر لک هذا الکلام علی سبیل الاختصار لتعرف الأسرار و تکون فیها من العارفین فاعلم ثمّ انصف فیما نلقی الیک لتکون من اهل الانصاف فی هذا المصاف بین یدی اللّه مذکورا

Wa-innī ḥīnaʾidhin ufassiru laka hādhā al-kalām ʿalā sabīl al-ikhtiṣār li-taʿrifa al-asrār wa-takūna fīhā min al-ʿārifīn fa-iʿlam thumma anṣif fīmā nulqī ilayka li-takūna min ahl al-inṣāf fī hādhā al-maṣāff bayna yaday Allāh madhkūran.

I will now briefly explain these words to you, so that you may recognize the mysteries and be among those who understand them. Learn, then, and judge fairly what We convey to you, so that in this arena you may be remembered before God as one of the fair-minded.

77

فاعلم بأنّ من تکلّم بهذا المقال فی میادین الجلال اراد ان یذکر اوصاف من یأتی باضمار و الغاز لئلّا یطّلع علیه اهل المجاز فأمّا قوله کانت عینتاه کلهیب النّار ما اراد الّا حدّة بصر من یأتی و قوّة بصیرته بحیث بعینتاه یحرق کلّ الحجبات و السّبحات و بها یعرف اسرار القدمیّة فی عوالم الملکیّة و یمیّز الّذین ترهق وجوههم قترة من الجحیم عن الّذین تعرف فی وجوههم نضرة النّعیم و لو لم یکن عینتاه من نار اللّه الموقدة کیف یحرق الحجبات و کلّ ما کان بین ایدی النّاس و یلاحظ آیات اللّه فی جبروت الأسمآء و ملکوت الأشیآء و یشهد الأشیآء بعین اللّه النّاظرة و کذلک جعلنا الیوم بصره حدیداً ان انتم بآیات اللّه موقنا و ایّ نار احرّ من هذه النّار الّتی تجلّی فی طور عینتیه و حرق بها کلّ ما احتجبوا به العباد فی اراضی الایجاد فسبحان اللّه عمّا ظهر فی الواح السّداد من اسرار المبدإ و المعاد الی یوم الّذی فیه ینادی المناد اذاً انّا کلّ الی اللّه منقلبون

Fa-iʿlam bi-anna man takallama bi-hādhā al-maqāl fī mayādīn al-jalāl arāda an yadhkura awṣāf man yaʾtī bi-iḍmār wa-alghāz li-allā yaṭṭaliʿa ʿalayhi ahl al-majāz fa-ammā qawluhu kānat ʿaynatāhu ka-lahīb al-nār mā arāda illā ḥiddat baṣar man yaʾtī wa-quwwat baṣīratihi bi-ḥayth bi-ʿaynatāhu yuḥriqu kull al-ḥujubāt wa-al-subuḥāt wa-bihā yaʿrifu asrār al-qidamiyya fī ʿawālim al-mulkiyya wa-yumayyizu alladhīna tarhaqu wujūhahum qatara min al-jaḥīm ʿan alladhīna taʿrifu fī wujūhihim naḍrat al-naʿīm wa-law lam yakun ʿaynatāhu min nār Allāh al-mūqada kayfa yuḥriqu al-ḥujubāt wa-kull mā kāna bayna aydī al-nās wa-yulāḥiẓu āyāt Allāh fī jabarūt al-asmāʾ wa-malakūt al-ashyāʾ wa-yashhadu al-ashyāʾ bi-ʿayn Allāh al-nāẓira wa-ka-dhālika jaʿalnā al-yawm baṣarahu ḥadīdan in antum bi-āyāt Allāh mūqinan wa-ayyu nār aḥarr min hādhihi al-nār allatī tajallā fī ṭūr ʿaynatayhi wa-ḥaraqa bihā kull mā iḥtajabū bihi al-ʿibād fī arāḍī al-ījād fa-subḥān Allāh ʿammā ẓahara fī alwāḥ al-sadād min asrār al-mabdaʾ wa-al-maʿād ilā yawm alladhī fīhi yunādī al-munād idhan innā kull ilā Allāh munqalibūn.

Know that the one who spoke these words in the arenas of glory intended to describe the attributes of the One who would come through concealed meanings and riddles, so that those attached to outward appearances would not discover Him. As for his saying, “His eyes were like a flame of fire,” he meant only the keenness of the sight of the One who would come and the power of His insight, such that with His eyes He burns away every veil and covering. Through them He recognizes the mysteries of eternity in the worlds of earthly dominion and distinguishes those whose faces are overspread with the gloom of hell from those in whose faces you recognize the radiance of bliss. If His eyes were not of God’s kindled fire, how could He burn away the veils and everything that is in people’s hands, behold the signs of God in the dominion of names and the kingdom of things, and witness all things through the all-seeing eye of God? Thus have We made His sight keen today, if you are certain of the signs of God. What fire is hotter than this fire that has shone upon the Sinai of His eyes, through which He has burned away everything by which the servants have veiled themselves in the lands of existence? Glory be to God for the mysteries of the beginning and the return that have appeared in the Tablets of rectitude, until the day when the caller proclaims: “Then, indeed, we are all returning to God.”

78

و قوله کانت رجلاه کالنّحاس ما اراد بذلک الّا الاستقامة حین الّذی یسمع ندآء اللّه فاستقم کما امرت لیستقیم علی امر اللّه و یقیم علی صراط قدرة اللّه بحیث لو ینکروه کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض ما تزّل قدماه عن التّبلیغ و ما یفرّ عمّا امره اللّه فی التّشریع و یکون رجلاه کالجبال الباذخة و القلل الشّامخة و یکون مستحکماً فی طاعة اللّه و قیّوماً فی اظهار امره و ابراز کلمته و لا یردّه منع مانع و لا یصدّه نهی معرض و لا یندمه انکار کافر و کلّما یشهد من الانکار و البغضآء و الکفر و الفحشآء یزداد فی محبّة اللّه و یزید الشّوق فی قلبه و یکثر الوله فی فؤاده و یبوح العشق فی صدره هل شهدت فی الأرض نحاساً احکم من ذلک او حدیداً اشدّ من ذلک او جبل اسکن من هذا لأنّه یقوم برجلاه فی مقابلة کلّ من علی الأرض و لا یخاف من احد مع ما انت تعرف فعل العباد فسبحان اللّه مسکنه و مبعثه و انّه هو المقتدر علی ما یشآء و انّه هو المهیمن القیّوم

Wa-qawluhu kānat rijlāhu ka-l-nuḥās mā arāda bi-dhālika illā al-istiqāma ḥīna alladhī yasmaʿ nidāʾ Allāh fa-staqim kamā umirta li-yastaqīm ʿalā amr Allāh wa-yuqīm ʿalā ṣirāṭ qudrat Allāh bi-ḥaythu law yunkirūhu kull man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ mā tazill qadamāhu ʿan al-tablīgh wa-mā yafirr ʿammā amarahu Allāh fī al-tashrīʿ wa-yakūn rijlāhu ka-l-jibāl al-bādhikha wa-l-qulal al-shāmikha wa-yakūn mustaḥkiman fī ṭāʿat Allāh wa-qayyūman fī iẓhār amrihi wa-ibrāz kalimatihi wa-lā yarudduhu manʿ māniʿ wa-lā yaṣudduhu nahy muʿriḍ wa-lā yundimuhu inkār kāfir wa-kullamā yashhad min al-inkār wa-l-baghḍāʾ wa-l-kufr wa-l-faḥshāʾ yazdād fī maḥabbat Allāh wa-yazīd al-shawq fī qalbihi wa-yakthur al-walah fī fuʾādihi wa-yabūḥ al-ʿishq fī ṣadrihi hal shahidta fī al-arḍ nuḥāsan aḥkam min dhālika aw ḥadīdan ashadd min dhālika aw jabal askan min hādhā li-annahu yaqūm bi-rijlāhi fī muqābalat kull man ʿalā al-arḍ wa-lā yakhāf min aḥad maʿa mā anta taʿrif fiʿl al-ʿibād fa-subḥān Allāh musakkinuhu wa-mubʿithuhu wa-innahu huwa al-Muqtadir ʿalā mā yashāʾ wa-innahu huwa al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm.

As for his saying, “His feet were like brass,” he meant only steadfastness when He hears the call of God: “Stand firm, as you have been commanded,” so that He may remain steadfast in the Cause of God and abide on the path of God’s power. Even if everyone in the heavens and on earth were to deny Him, His feet would not falter in proclaiming the message, nor would He flee from what God has commanded Him to ordain. His feet would be like towering mountains and lofty peaks. He would be firm in obedience to God and unwavering in manifesting His Cause and setting forth His Word. No one’s obstruction would turn Him back, no opponent’s prohibition would deter Him, and no unbeliever’s denial would cause Him regret. Whatever denial, hatred, unbelief, and wickedness He witnesses, His love for God increases, the longing in His heart grows, the ardor in His inmost being intensifies, and love declares itself within His breast. Have you seen on earth brass firmer than this, iron stronger than this, or a mountain more immovable than this? For He stands on His feet against everyone on earth and fears no one, despite what you know of people’s deeds. Glory be to God, who gives Him repose and raises Him up! He indeed has power over whatever He wills, and He is the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.

79

و کان یخرج من فمه سیف ذا فمین فاعلم بأنّ السّیف لمّا کان آلة القطع و الفصل و من فم الأنبیآء و الأولیآء یخرج ما یفصل بین المؤمن و الکافر و یقطع بین المحبّ و المحبوب لذا سمّی بهذا و انّه ما اراد بذلک الّا القطع و الفصل مثلاً نقطة الأوّلیّة و الشّمس الأزلیّة فی حین الّذی یرید ان یحشر الخلائق باذن اللّه و یبعثهم من مراقد نفوسهم و یفصل بینهم لینطق بآیة من عند اللّه و هذه الآیة تفصل بین الحقّ و الباطل من یومئذ الی یوم القیامة و ایّ سیف احدّ من هذا السّیف الأحدیّة و ایّ صمصام اشحذ من هذا الصّمصام الصّمدیّة الّذی یقطع کلّ النّسبة و بذلک یفصل بین المقبل و المعرض و بین الأب و الابن و الأخ و الأخت و العاشق و المعشوق لأنّ من آمن بما نزّل علیه فهو مؤمن و من اعرض فهو کافر و یظهر الفصل بین هذا المؤمن و هذا الکافر بحیث لا یعاشرا و لا یجتمعا فی الملک ابداً و کذلک فی الأب و الابن و انّ الابن لو یؤمن و الأب ینکر یفصل بینهما و لا یجانسا ابداً بل تشهد بأنّ الابن یقتل الأب و بالعکس و کذلک فاعرف کلّ ما ذکرنا و بیّنّا و فصّلنا

Wa-kāna yakhruj min famihi sayf dhā famayn fa-ʿlam bi-anna al-sayf lammā kāna ālat al-qaṭʿ wa-l-faṣl wa-min fam al-anbiyāʾ wa-l-awliyāʾ yakhruj mā yafṣil bayna al-muʾmin wa-l-kāfir wa-yaqṭaʿ bayna al-muḥibb wa-l-maḥbūb li-dhā summiya bi-hādhā wa-innahu mā arāda bi-dhālika illā al-qaṭʿ wa-l-faṣl mathalan nuqṭat al-awwaliyya wa-l-shams al-azaliyya fī ḥīn alladhī yurīd an yaḥshur al-khalāʾiq bi-idhn Allāh wa-yabʿathahum min marāqid nufūsihim wa-yafṣil baynahum la-yanṭiq bi-āya min ʿind Allāh wa-hādhihi al-āya tafṣil bayna al-ḥaqq wa-l-bāṭil min yawmiʾidh ilā yawm al-qiyāma wa-ayy sayf aḥadd min hādhā al-sayf al-aḥadiyya wa-ayy ṣamṣām ashḥadh min hādhā al-ṣamṣām al-ṣamadiyya alladhī yaqṭaʿ kull al-nisba wa-bi-dhālika yafṣil bayna al-muqbil wa-l-muʿriḍ wa-bayna al-ab wa-l-ibn wa-l-akh wa-l-ukht wa-l-ʿāshiq wa-l-maʿshūq li-anna man āmana bi-mā nuzzila ʿalayhi fa-huwa muʾmin wa-man aʿraḍ fa-huwa kāfir wa-yaẓhar al-faṣl bayna hādhā al-muʾmin wa-hādhā al-kāfir bi-ḥaythu lā yuʿāshirā wa-lā yajtamiʿā fī al-mulk abadan wa-ka-dhālika fī al-ab wa-l-ibn wa-inna al-ibn law yuʾmin wa-l-ab yunkir yufṣal baynahumā wa-lā yatajānasā abadan bal tashhad bi-anna al-ibn yaqtul al-ab wa-bi-l-ʿaks wa-ka-dhālika fa-ʿrif kull mā dhakarnā wa-bayyannā wa-faṣṣalnā.

“And from His mouth came a two-edged sword.” Know that, since the sword is an instrument of cutting and separation, and from the mouths of the Prophets and the holy ones comes what separates the believer from the unbeliever and severs the lover from the beloved, it was given this name. By this he meant only cutting and separation. For example, when the Primal Point and the eternal Sun wishes to gather together all creatures by God’s leave, raise them from the resting places of their own selves, and separate them from one another, He utters a verse from God. This verse separates truth from falsehood from that day until the Day of Resurrection. What sword is sharper than this sword of oneness, and what blade keener than this blade of eternal self-sufficiency, which severs every tie? Through it He separates those who turn toward Him from those who turn away, father from son, brother from sister, and lover from beloved. For whoever believes in what has been sent down to Him is a believer, and whoever turns away is an unbeliever. The separation between this believer and this unbeliever becomes such that they will never associate or come together in the world. So too with father and son: if the son believes and the father denies, they are separated and will never be of one kind. Indeed, you see the son killing the father, and the reverse. In this way, understand everything We have mentioned, explained, and set forth in detail.

80

و انّک لو تشهد بعین الیقین لتشهد بأنّ هذا السّیف الالهی لیفصل بین الأصلاب لو انتم تعلمون و هذه من کلمة الفصل الّتی تظهر فی یوم الفصل و الطّلاق لو کانوا النّاس فی ایّام ربّهم یتذکّرون بل لو تدقّ بصرک و ترقّ قلبک لتشهد بأنّ کلّ السّیوف الظّاهریّة الّتی تقتل الکفّار و تجاهد مع الفجّار فی کلّ دهر و زمان یظهر من هذا السّیف الباطنیّة الالهیّة اذاً فافتح عیناک لتجد کلّ ما اریناک و تبلغ الی ما لا یبلغ الیه احد من العالمین و نقول الحمد لله اذ هو مالک یوم الدّین

Wa-innaka law tashhad bi-ʿayn al-yaqīn la-tashhad bi-anna hādhā al-sayf al-ilāhī la-yafṣil bayna al-aṣlāb law antum taʿlamūn wa-hādhihi min kalimat al-faṣl allatī taẓhar fī yawm al-faṣl wa-l-ṭalāq law kānū al-nās fī ayyām rabbihim yatadhakkarūn bal law tudiqq baṣaraka wa-turiqq qalbaka la-tashhad bi-anna kull al-suyūf al-ẓāhiriyya allatī taqtul al-kuffār wa-tujāhid maʿa al-fujjār fī kull dahr wa-zamān yaẓhar min hādhā al-sayf al-bāṭiniyya al-ilāhiyya idhan fa-ftaḥ ʿaynāka li-tajid kull mā araynāka wa-tablugh ilā mā lā yablugh ilayhi aḥad min al-ʿālamīn wa-naqūl al-ḥamdu li-llāh idh huwa mālik yawm al-dīn.

If you were to behold with the eye of certainty, you would see that this divine sword divides even the loins, if only you knew. This proceeds from the word of separation that appears on the day of separation and sundering, if only people would take heed in the days of their Lord. Indeed, if you sharpened your sight and softened your heart, you would see that all the outward swords that slay unbelievers and wage war against the wicked in every age and time proceed from this inward, divine sword. Open your eyes, then, to discover everything We have shown you and attain what no one among all peoples has attained. And We say: “Praise be to God, for He is the Master of the Day of Judgment.”

81

و هؤلآء العباد لمّا ما اخذوا العلم من معدنه و محلّه و عن بحر العذب الفرات السّائغ الّذی یجری باذن اللّه فی قلوب الصّافیة السّاذجیّة لذا احتجبوا عن مراد اللّه فی کلماته و اشاراته و کانوا فی سجن انفسهم لساکنین

Wa-hāʾulāʾ al-ʿibād lammā mā akhadhū al-ʿilm min maʿdinihi wa-maḥallihi wa-ʿan baḥr al-ʿadhb al-furāt al-sāʾigh alladhī yajrī bi-idhn Allāh fī qulūb al-ṣāfiya al-sādhijiyya li-dhā iḥtajabū ʿan murād Allāh fī kalimātihi wa-ishārātihi wa-kānū fī sijn anfusihim la-sākinīn.

Because these servants did not draw knowledge from its source and proper place, or from the sweet, fresh, palatable sea that flows by God’s leave within pure and unalloyed hearts, they were veiled from God’s intention in His words and allusions, and remained dwelling in the prison of their own selves.

82

و انّا نشکر اللّه بما اتانا من فضله و جعلنا موقناً بأمره الّذی لا یقوم معه السّموات و الأرض و مقرّاً به یوم لقائه و بمن یظهره اللّه فی قیامة الأخری و جعلنا من الموقنین به قبل ظهوره لتکون النّعمة من عنده بالغة علینا و علی العالمین

Wa-innā nashkur Allāh bi-mā ātānā min faḍlihi wa-jaʿalanā mūqinan bi-amrihi alladhī lā yaqūm maʿahu al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ wa-muqirran bihi yawm liqāʾihi wa-bi-man yuẓhiruhu Allāh fī qiyāmat al-ukhrā wa-jaʿalanā min al-mūqinīn bihi qabla ẓuhūrihi li-takūn al-niʿma min ʿindihi bāligha ʿalaynā wa-ʿalā al-ʿālamīn.

We thank God for what He has bestowed upon Us through His grace, and for making Us certain of His Cause, before which the heavens and the earth cannot stand, acknowledging Him on the day of meeting Him and acknowledging Him whom God will make manifest in the next Resurrection. He has made Us among those certain of Him before His manifestation, so that His favor to Us and to all the worlds may be complete.

83

ولکن اشکو الیک یا اخی عن الّذین ینسبون انفسهم الی اللّه و مظاهر علمه و یرتکبون الفواحش و یأکلون اموال النّاس و یشربون الخمر و یقتلون الأنفس و یسرقون الأموال بینهم و یغتبون بعضهم بعضاً و یفترون علی اللّه و یکذبون فی اکثر اقوالهم و یرجع النّاس کلّ ذلک الینا و انّهم ما [استحیون] عن اللّه و یترکون ما امرهم اللّه و یرتکبون ما نهوا عنه بعد الّذی ینبغی لأهل الحقّ بأن یظهر آثار الخضوع عن وجوههم و انوار القدس من طلعاتهم و یمشوا فی الأرض بمثل من یمشی بین یدی اللّه و یکون ممتازاً عن کلّ من علی الأرض بجمیع الحرکات و السّکنات بحیث یشاهدوا آثار القدرة بعیونهم و یذکروا اللّه بألسنهم و قلوبهم و یمشوا الی اوطان القرب بأرجلهم و یأخذوا احکام اللّه بأیادیهم و لو یمضون علی وادی الذّهب و معادن الفضّة ما یعتنون بهما و لا یلتفتون الیهما

Wa-lākin ashkū ilayka yā akhī ʿan alladhīna yansibūn anfusahum ilā Allāh wa-maẓāhir ʿilmihi wa-yartakibūn al-fawāḥish wa-yaʾkulūn amwāl al-nās wa-yashrabūn al-khamr wa-yaqtulūn al-anfus wa-yasriqūn al-amwāl baynahum wa-yaghtābūn baʿḍuhum baʿḍan wa-yaftarūn ʿalā Allāh wa-yakdhibūn fī akthar aqwālihim wa-yurjiʿ al-nās kull dhālika ilaynā wa-innahum mā [istaḥyūn] ʿan Allāh wa-yatrukūn mā amarahum Allāh wa-yartakibūn mā nuhū ʿanhu baʿda alladhī yanbaghī li-ahl al-ḥaqq bi-an yaẓhar āthār al-khuḍūʿ ʿan wujūhihim wa-anwār al-quds min ṭalaʿātihim wa-yamshū fī al-arḍ bi-mithl man yamshī bayna yaday Allāh wa-yakūn mumtāzan ʿan kull man ʿalā al-arḍ bi-jamīʿ al-ḥarakāt wa-l-sakanāt bi-ḥaythu yushāhidū āthār al-qudra bi-ʿuyūnihim wa-yadhkurū Allāh bi-alsunihim wa-qulūbihim wa-yamshū ilā awṭān al-qurb bi-arjulihim wa-yaʾkhudhū aḥkām Allāh bi-ayādīhim wa-law yamḍūn ʿalā wādī al-dhahab wa-maʿādin al-fiḍḍa mā yaʿtanūn bi-himā wa-lā yaltafitūn ilayhimā.

But I complain to you, My brother, of those who claim affiliation with God and the Manifestations of His knowledge, yet commit indecencies, devour people’s wealth, drink wine, take lives, steal property from one another, backbite one another, invent falsehoods about God, and lie in most of what they say. People attribute all this to Us. They feel no shame before God, abandon what God has commanded them, and commit what they have been forbidden, whereas the people of truth should show signs of humility in their faces and the lights of holiness in their countenances. They should walk the earth like one walking in God’s presence and be distinguished from everyone on earth in every movement and moment of stillness, so that with their eyes they witness the signs of His power, with their tongues and hearts they remember God, with their feet they walk toward the homelands of nearness, and with their hands they take hold of God’s ordinances. Were they to pass through a valley of gold and mines of silver, they would pay them no heed and would not turn toward them.

84

و انّ هؤلآء اعرضوا عن کلّ ذلک و اقبلوا الی ما تهوی به هواهم و انّهم فی وادی الکبر و الغرور لیهیمون و اشهد حینئذ بأنّ اللّه کان بریء عنهم و نحن برآء و نسأل اللّه بأن لا یجمعنا و ایّاهم لا فی الدّنیا و لا فی الآخرة اذ انّه هو الحقّ لا اله الّا هو و انّه کان علی کلّ شیء قدیر

Wa-inna hāʾulāʾ aʿraḍū ʿan kull dhālika wa-aqbalū ilā mā tahwā bihi hawāhum wa-innahum fī wādī al-kibr wa-l-ghurūr la-yahīmūn wa-ashhad ḥīnaʾidh bi-anna Allāh kāna barīʾ ʿanhum wa-naḥnu barāʾ wa-nasʾal Allāh bi-an lā yajmaʿanā wa-iyyāhum lā fī al-dunyā wa-lā fī al-ākhira idh innahu huwa al-Ḥaqq lā ilāha illā huwa wa-innahu kāna ʿalā kull shayʾ qadīr.

Yet these people have turned away from all this and turned toward whatever their desires crave. They wander in the valley of pride and delusion. I testify, therefore, that God is clear of them, and We are clear of them. We ask God not to bring Us together with them, either in this world or in the next. He indeed is the Truth; there is no god but Him, and He has power over all things.

85

اذاً فاشرب یا اخی من هذا المآء الّذی اجریناه فی ابحر تلک الکلمات کأنّ بحور العظمة متموّجات فیها و جواهر الأحدیّة مشعشعات لها و بها و علیها فانّک فاخلع ثیابک عمّا یحجبک عن الدّخول فی هذا البحر اللّجّیّ الحمرآء فقل بسم اللّه و باللّه ثمّ ادخل فیها و لا تخف من احد و توکّل علی اللّه ربّک و من یتوکّل علی اللّه فهو حسبه فانّه هو یحفظک و تکون فیه من الآمنین

Idhan fa-shrab yā akhī min hādhā al-māʾ alladhī ajraynāhu fī abḥur tilka al-kalimāt ka-anna buḥūr al-ʿaẓama mutamawwijāt fīhā wa-jawāhir al-aḥadiyya mushaʿshiʿāt lahā wa-bihā wa-ʿalayhā fa-innaka fa-khlaʿ thiyābaka ʿammā yaḥjubuka ʿan al-dukhūl fī hādhā al-baḥr al-lujjī al-ḥamrāʾ fa-qul bi-smi Allāh wa-bi-llāh thumma udkhul fīhā wa-lā takhaf min aḥad wa-tawakkal ʿalā Allāh rabbika wa-man yatawakkal ʿalā Allāh fa-huwa ḥasbuhu fa-innahu huwa yaḥfaẓuka wa-takūn fīhi min al-āminīn.

Drink, then, My brother, of this water that We have caused to flow in the seas of these words. It is as though the oceans of grandeur surge within them and the jewels of oneness shine for them, through them, and upon them. Strip off the garments of whatever prevents you from entering this deep crimson sea. Say, “In the name of God and through God,” then enter it. Fear no one, and place your trust in God, your Lord. “Whoever places his trust in God, He is sufficient for him.” He will indeed protect you, and within it you will be among those who are safe.

86

ثمّ اعلم بأنّ فی هذه المدینة الألطف الأبهی تجد السّالک خاضعاً لکلّ الوجوه و خاشعاً لکلّ الأشیآء لأنّه لا یشهد شیئاً الّا و قد یری اللّه فیه و یشهد نوره فیما احاطت انوار الظّهور علی طور الممکنات و فی ذلک المقام حقّ علیه بأن لا یجلس علی صدور المجالس لافتخار نفسه و لا یتقدّم علی نفس لاستکبار نفسه و یشهد نفسه فی کلّ حین بین یدی مولاه و لا یرضی لوجه ما لا یرضی لوجهه و لا یقول لأحد ما لا یقدر ان یسمعه من غیره و لا یحبّ لأحد ما لا یحبّه لنفسه و یحرّک فی الأرض علی خیط الاستوآء فی ملکوت البدآء

Thumma iʿlam bi-anna fī hādhihi al-madīna al-alṭaf al-abhā tajid al-sālik khāḍiʿan li-kull al-wujūh wa-khāshiʿan li-kull al-ashyāʾ li-annahu lā yashhad shayʾan illā wa-qad yarā Allāh fīhi wa-yashhad nūrahu fī-mā aḥāṭat anwār al-ẓuhūr ʿalā ṭūr al-mumkināt wa-fī dhālika al-maqām ḥaqq ʿalayhi bi-an lā yajlis ʿalā ṣudūr al-majālis li-iftikhār nafsihi wa-lā yataqaddam ʿalā nafs li-istikbār nafsihi wa-yashhad nafsahu fī kull ḥīn bayna yaday mawlāhu wa-lā yarḍā li-wajh mā lā yarḍā li-wajhihi wa-lā yaqūl li-aḥad mā lā yaqdir an yasmaʿahu min ghayrihi wa-lā yuḥibb li-aḥad mā lā yuḥibbuhu li-nafsihi wa-yuḥarrik fī al-arḍ ʿalā khayṭ al-istiwāʾ fī malakūt al-badāʾ.

Know, moreover, that in this most subtle and most glorious city you will find the wayfarer humble before every face and reverent before all things, for he beholds nothing without seeing God within it, and witnesses His light in all that the lights of revelation have encompassed upon the Sinai of contingent existence. In this station he must not occupy the seats of honor in gatherings to glorify himself, nor take precedence over anyone out of self-importance. He must see himself at every moment in his Lord’s presence, not approve for anyone what he would not approve for himself, not say to anyone what he could not bear to hear from another, and not wish for anyone what he would not wish for himself. He must move upon the earth along the line of rectitude in the kingdom of unfolding decree.

87

ولکن اعلم بأنّ السّالک فی اوائل سلوکه کما ذکرنا من قبل لیری التّبدیل و التّغییر و هذا حقّ لا ریب فیه کما نزل فی وصف تلک الأیّام یوم تبدّل الأرض غیر الأرض و هذا من ایّام الّذی ما شهدت العیون بمثلها فطوبی لمن ادرکها و عرف قدرها و لقد ارسلنا موسی بآیاتنا ان اخرج القوم من الظّلمات الی النّور و ذکّرهم بأیّام اللّه و هذا من ایّام اللّه لو انتم تعرفون

Wa-lākin iʿlam bi-anna al-sālik fī awāʾil sulūkihi kamā dhakarnā min qabl la-yarā al-tabdīl wa-l-taghyīr wa-hādhā ḥaqq lā rayb fīhi kamā nazala fī waṣf tilka al-ayyām yawm tubaddal al-arḍ ghayr al-arḍ wa-hādhā min ayyām alladhī mā shahidat al-ʿuyūn bi-mithlihā fa-ṭūbā li-man adrakahā wa-ʿarafa qadrahā wa-la-qad arsalnā Mūsā bi-āyātinā an akhrij al-qawm min al-ẓulumāt ilā al-nūr wa-dhakkirhum bi-ayyām Allāh wa-hādhā min ayyām Allāh law antum taʿrifūn.

But know that, at the beginning of his journey, the wayfarer indeed sees transformation and change, as We mentioned before. This is a truth beyond doubt, as was revealed in describing those days: “The day when the earth is changed into another earth.” This is one of those days whose like no eyes have witnessed. Blessed is the one who attains them and recognizes their worth. “We indeed sent Moses with Our signs: ‘Bring the people out of darkness into light, and remind them of the days of God.’” This is one of the days of God, if only you knew.

88

و فی هذا المقام کلّ المتغایرات و المتبدّلات لموجود بین یدیک و من اقرّ بغیر ذلک فقد الحد فی امر اللّه و نازعه فی سلطانه و حاربه فی حکومته و من یبدّل الأرض و یجعلها غیر الأرض لیقدر ان یبدّل کلّ ما علیها و ما یحرّک علی ظهرها و لا تستعجب عن ذلک کما بدّل الظّلمة بالنّور و النّور بالظّلمة و الجهل بالعلم و الضّلالة بالهدایة و الموت بالحیاة و الحیاة بالموت و فی ذلک المقام یثبت حکم التّبدیل ان تکون من اهل هذا السّبیل فکّر فیه لیظهر لک ما طلبت عن هذا الذّلیل من سرادق هذا الدّلیل لتکون فیه من السّاکنین لأنّه یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید و لا یسأل عمّا یفعل و کلّ عن کلّ یسألون

Wa-fī hādhā al-maqām kull al-mutaghāyirāt wa-l-mutabaddilāt la-mawjūd bayna yadayka wa-man aqarra bi-ghayr dhālika fa-qad alḥada fī amr Allāh wa-nāzaʿahu fī sulṭānihi wa-ḥārabahu fī ḥukūmatihi wa-man yubaddil al-arḍ wa-yajʿaluhā ghayr al-arḍ la-yaqdir an yubaddil kull mā ʿalayhā wa-mā yuḥarrik ʿalā ẓahrihā wa-lā tastaʿjib ʿan dhālika kamā baddala al-ẓulma bi-l-nūr wa-l-nūr bi-l-ẓulma wa-l-jahl bi-l-ʿilm wa-l-ḍalāla bi-l-hidāya wa-l-mawt bi-l-ḥayā wa-l-ḥayā bi-l-mawt wa-fī dhālika al-maqām yathbut ḥukm al-tabdīl in takūn min ahl hādhā al-sabīl fakkir fīhi li-yaẓhar laka mā ṭalabta ʿan hādhā al-dhalīl min surādiq hādhā al-dalīl li-takūn fīhi min al-sākinīn li-annahu yafʿal mā yashāʾ wa-yaḥkum mā yurīd wa-lā yusʾal ʿammā yafʿal wa-kull ʿan kull yusʾalūn.

In this station, all changing and transformed things are present before you. Whoever affirms otherwise has strayed in the Cause of God, disputed His sovereignty, and waged war against His rule. He who changes the earth and makes it another earth is indeed able to change everything upon it and everything moving across its surface. Do not be astonished at this, for He has changed darkness into light and light into darkness, ignorance into knowledge, error into guidance, death into life, and life into death. In this station the rule of transformation is established, if you are among those who follow this path. Reflect upon it, so that what you have sought from this lowly One may appear to you from the pavilion of this proof, and you may be among those dwelling within it. For He does whatever He wills and ordains whatever He desires. He is not questioned about what He does, while all are questioned about everything.

89
