ولکن یا اخی لتری فی هذه الرّتبة ای فی اوّل السّلوک کما ذکرنا فی مدینة الطّلب مقامات مختلفة و علامات متفاوتة و کلّها حقّ فی مواقعها و مقاماتها و ینبغی لجنابک فی هذا المقام بأن تشهد کلّ الأشیآء فی اماکنها من دون ان تنزل شیئاً عن صعودها و علوّها او ترفع شیئاً من مقامها و دنوّها مثلاً انّک لو تحلّ اللّاهوت فی النّاسوت هذا شرک محض و لو تصعد النّاسوت الی هوآء اللّاهوت هذا کفر صرف ولکن لو تذکر اللّاهوت فی اللّاهوت و النّاسوت فی النّاسوت لحقّ لا ریب فیه ای انّ جنابک لو تشهد التّبدیل فی عوالم التّوحید هذا ذنب لم یکن فی الملک اکبر من ذلک و ان تشهد التّبدیل فی مقامه و تعرفه علی ما ینبغی لا بأس علیک

Wa-lākin yā akhī la-tarā fī hādhihi al-rutba ay fī awwal al-sulūk kamā dhakarnā fī madīnat al-ṭalab maqāmāt mukhtalifa wa-ʿalāmāt mutafāwita wa-kulluhā ḥaqq fī mawāqiʿihā wa-maqāmātihā wa-yanbaghī li-janābika fī hādhā al-maqām bi-an tashhad kull al-ashyāʾ fī amākinihā min dūn an tunazzil shayʾan ʿan ṣuʿūdihā wa-ʿuluwwihā aw tarfaʿ shayʾan min maqāmihā wa-dunuwwihā mathalan innaka law tuḥill al-lāhūt fī al-nāsūt hādhā shirk maḥḍ wa-law tuṣʿid al-nāsūt ilā hawāʾ al-lāhūt hādhā kufr ṣirf wa-lākin law tadhkur al-lāhūt fī al-lāhūt wa-l-nāsūt fī al-nāsūt la-ḥaqq lā rayb fīhi ay inna janābaka law tashhad al-tabdīl fī ʿawālim al-tawḥīd hādhā dhanb lam yakun fī al-mulk akbar min dhālika wa-in tashhad al-tabdīl fī maqāmihi wa-taʿrifahu ʿalā mā yanbaghī lā baʾs ʿalayka.

But, My brother, in this degree—that is, at the beginning of the journey, as We mentioned in the city of search—you will see different stations and varying signs. All are true in their proper places and stations. In this station you should behold all things in their proper places, without bringing anything down from its elevation and loftiness or raising anything from its station and lowliness. For example, if you were to make divinity dwell within humanity, this would be sheer association of partners with God; and if you were to raise humanity into the atmosphere of divinity, this would be pure unbelief. But if you speak of divinity in divinity and humanity in humanity, this is a truth beyond doubt. That is, if you were to behold transformation in the worlds of divine unity, this would be a sin greater than any in existence. But if you behold transformation in its proper station and understand it as you should, no blame rests upon you.

90

و انّی فوربّی کلّ ما القیناک من اسرار البیان و مقامات التّبیان فی العیان کأنّی ما ذکرت حرفاً من بحر علم اللّه المکنونة و جوهر حکمة اللّه المخزونة و سنذکر فی حینها اذا شآء اللّه و اراد و انّه هو ذاکر کلّ شیء فی مقامها و انّا کلّ له ذاکرون

Wa-innī fa-wa-rabbī kullu mā alqaynāka min asrār al-bayān wa-maqāmāt al-tibyān fī al-ʿiyān ka-annī mā dhakartu ḥarfan min baḥr ʿilm Allāh al-maknūna wa-jawhar ḥikmat Allāh al-makhzūna wa-sanadhkuru fī ḥīnihā idhā shāʾa Allāh wa-arāda wa-innahu huwa dhākiru kull shayʾ fī maqāmihā wa-innā kullun lahu dhākirūn.

By My Lord, despite all We have imparted to you of the mysteries of expression and the stations of explanation made manifest, it is as though I had not mentioned a single letter from the ocean of God’s hidden knowledge and the essence of His treasured wisdom. We shall speak of these in their time, if God so wills and desires. He indeed makes mention of everything in its proper station, and We all make mention of Him.

91

ثمّ اعلم بأنّ طیر الّتی تطیر فی هوآء الجبروت لن تقدر ان تطیر فی سمآء قدس اللّاهوت و لن تقدر ان تمذق فواکه الّتی خلق اللّه فیها و لن تقدر ان تشرب انهار الّتی جرت فیها و لو تشرب قطرة منها لتموت فی الحین کما تشهد فی تلک الأیّام عن الّذین ینسبون انفسهم الینا و یفعلون ما یفعلون و یقولون ما یقولون و یدّعون ما یدّعون و کأنّهم فی حجباتهم میّتون

Thumma iʿlam bi-anna ṭayr allatī taṭīru fī hawāʾ al-jabarūt lan taqdira an taṭīra fī samāʾ quds al-lāhūt wa-lan taqdira an tamdhuqa fawākih allatī khalaqa Allāh fīhā wa-lan taqdira an tashraba anhār allatī jarat fīhā wa-law tashrabu qaṭratan minhā la-tamūtu fī al-ḥīn kamā tashhadu fī tilka al-ayyām ʿan alladhīna yansibūna anfusahum ilaynā wa-yafʿalūna mā yafʿalūna wa-yaqūlūna mā yaqūlūna wa-yaddaʿūna mā yaddaʿūna wa-ka-annahum fī ḥujubātihim mayyitūn.

Know, then, that the bird that flies in the atmosphere of dominion cannot fly in the heaven of the holiness of divinity, nor can it mingle the fruits God has created there or drink from the rivers that flow there. Were it to drink a drop from them, it would die at once, as you witness in these days among those who ascribe themselves to Us, yet do what they do, say what they say, and claim what they claim. It is as though they were dead within their veils.

92

کذلک فاعرف کلّ المقامات و الاشارات و الدّلالات و تعرف کلّ شیء فی مکانه و تجد کلّ امر فی مقامه و لهذا المقام ای مقام مدینة الأحدیّة رجال قد رکبوا علی فلک الهدایة و سافروا فی معارج الأحدیّة [و تشهد انوار الجمال عن وجوههم و اسرار الجلال من هیاکلهم] و تجد روائح المسک من کلماتهم و تلاحظ آیات السّلطنة فی مشیهم و حرکاتهم و سکونهم و لا یحجبک اعمال الّذینهم ما شربوا من عیون الصّافیة و ما وصلوا الی مدائن القدسیّة و یتّبعون اهوآء انفسهم و یفسدون فی الأرض و یحسبون بأنّهم مهتدون هم الّذین ورد فی شأنهم همج رعاع اتباع کلّ ناعق یمیلون بکلّ ریح و مراتب هذا السّفر و هذا المقام و هذا الوطن معلوم عند جنابک و مشهود عند حضرتک لا یحتاج الی تطویل الکلام

Kadhālika fa-iʿraf kulla al-maqāmāt wa-al-ishārāt wa-al-dalālāt wa-taʿrifu kulla shayʾ fī makānihi wa-tajidu kulla amr fī maqāmihi wa-li-hādhā al-maqām ay maqām madīnat al-aḥadiyya rijāl qad rakibū ʿalā fulk al-hidāya wa-sāfarū fī maʿārij al-aḥadiyya [wa-tashhadu anwār al-jamāl ʿan wujūhihim wa-asrār al-jalāl min hayākilihim] wa-tajidu rawāʾiḥ al-misk min kalimātihim wa-tulāḥiẓu āyāt al-salṭana fī mashyihim wa-ḥarakātihim wa-sukūnihim wa-lā yaḥjubka aʿmāl alladhīnahum mā sharibū min ʿuyūn al-ṣāfiya wa-mā waṣalū ilā madāʾin al-qudsiyya wa-yattabiʿūna ahwāʾ anfusihim wa-yufsidūna fī al-arḍ wa-yaḥsabūna bi-annahum muhtadūn hum alladhīna warada fī shaʾnihim hamajun raʿāʿ atbāʿu kulli nāʿiq yamīlūna bi-kulli rīḥ wa-marātib hādhā al-safar wa-hādhā al-maqām wa-hādhā al-waṭan maʿlūm ʿinda janābika wa-mashhūd ʿinda ḥaḍratika lā yaḥtāju ilā taṭwīl al-kalām.

Understand all the stations, allusions, and indications in this way, and you will recognize everything in its proper place and find every matter in its proper station. To this station—that is, the station of the city of oneness—belong men who have embarked upon the ark of guidance and journeyed along the ascending paths of oneness. [You behold the lights of beauty shining from their faces and the mysteries of majesty from their persons.] You perceive the fragrance of musk in their words and observe the signs of sovereignty in their gait, their movements, and their stillness. Do not let yourself be veiled by the deeds of those who have not drunk from the pure springs or reached the cities of holiness, who follow their own desires, spread corruption on earth, and imagine themselves rightly guided. They are those of whom it has been said: “A mindless rabble, followers of every clamorous voice, swaying with every wind.” The degrees of this journey, this station, and this homeland are known to you and evident to your eyes; there is no need to dwell on them at length.

93

ثمّ اعلم بأنّ کلّ ما شهدت و سمعت بأنّ شمس الحقیقة و النّقطة الأوّلیّة نسب الی نفسه من اسمآء القبل لم یکن ذلک الّا من ضعف العباد و هندسة عوالم الایجاد والّا کلّ الأسمآء و الصّفات یطوفنّ حول ذاته و یدورنّ فی فنآء حرمه بل هو مربّی الأسمآء و مظهر الصّفات و مذوّت الذّوات و معلن الآیات و مطرّز العلامات بل انّ جنابک لو تشهد بعین سرّک لتجد ما دونه مفقود عنده و معدوم فی ساحته کان اللّه و لم یکن معه من شیء و الآن کان بمثل ما قد کان و لمّا ثبت بأنّه جلّ و عزّ کان و لم یکن معه من شیء کیف یجری حکم التّبدیل و التّغییر و انّک اذاً تفکّر فیما القیناک لتظهر لک شمس الهدایة فی هذا الصّبح الأزلیّة و تکون فیه من الزّاهدین

Thumma iʿlam bi-anna kulla mā shahidta wa-samiʿta bi-anna shams al-ḥaqīqa wa-al-nuqṭa al-awwaliyya nasaba ilā nafsihi min asmāʾ al-qabl lam yakun dhālika illā min ḍaʿf al-ʿibād wa-handasat ʿawālim al-ījād wa-illā kullu al-asmāʾ wa-al-ṣifāt yaṭufna ḥawla dhātihi wa-yadurna fī fināʾ ḥaramihi bal huwa murabbī al-asmāʾ wa-maẓhar al-ṣifāt wa-mudhawwit al-dhawāt wa-muʿlin al-āyāt wa-muṭarriz al-ʿalāmāt bal inna janābaka law tashhadu bi-ʿayn sirrika la-tajidu mā dūnahu mafqūdan ʿindahu wa-maʿdūman fī sāḥatihi kāna Allāh wa-lam yakun maʿahu min shayʾ wa-al-āna kāna bi-mithli mā qad kāna wa-lammā thabata bi-annahu jalla wa-ʿazza kāna wa-lam yakun maʿahu min shayʾ kayfa yajrī ḥukm al-tabdīl wa-al-taghyīr wa-innaka idhan tafakkar fīmā alqaynāka li-taẓhara laka shams al-hidāya fī hādhā al-ṣubḥ al-azaliyya wa-takūna fīhi min al-zāhidīn.

Know, then, that whenever you have seen or heard that the Sun of Truth and the Primal Point ascribed to Himself any of the names of the past, this was solely because of the weakness of His servants and the ordering of the worlds of creation. Otherwise, all names and attributes circle around His Essence and revolve within the precincts of His sanctuary. Indeed, He is the nurturer of names, the manifestation of attributes, the giver of essence to all essences, the revealer of signs, and the embellisher of tokens. Were you to behold with your inner eye, you would find all besides Him absent in His presence and nonexistent in His court. “God was, and nothing was with Him,” and now He is as He has ever been. Since it is established that He—glorified and exalted be He—was, and nothing was with Him, how can the law of alteration and change apply? Reflect, then, upon what We have imparted to you, so that the sun of guidance may appear to you in this eternal dawn and you may be among those who are detached within it.

94

ثمّ اعلم بأن کلّ ما ذکرنا فی ذکر الأسفار لم یکن الّا للأحبار من الأخیار و انّک لو ترکب علی براق المعنوی و تسیر فی حدائق الالهی لتقطع کلّ الأسفار و تطّلع علی الأسرار من قبل ان ترتدّ الیک الأبصار

Thumma iʿlam bi-anna kulla mā dhakarnā fī dhikr al-asfār lam yakun illā li-al-aḥbār min al-akhyār wa-innaka law tarkabu ʿalā burāq al-maʿnawī wa-tasīru fī ḥadāʾiq al-ilāhī la-taqṭaʿu kulla al-asfār wa-taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā al-asrār min qabli an tartadda ilayka al-abṣār.

Know, then, that all We have said in describing these journeys was intended only for the learned among the righteous. Were you to mount the steed of the spirit and travel through the divine gardens, you would traverse all these journeys and discover the mysteries before your eyes could turn back to you.

95

اذاً یا اخی ان تکون من فارس هذا المیدان فارکض فی ممالک الایقان لتخلّص نفسک عن سجن الشّرک فی هذا الزّمان و تجد رائحة المسکیّة من نفحات هذه الحدیقة و من عطر هذه المدینة تفرّقت نسمات العطریّة فی اقطار العالم و انّک لا تحرم نصیبک و لا تکن من الغافلین

Idhan yā akhī in takūna min fāris hādhā al-maydān fa-urkuḍ fī mamālik al-īqān li-tukhalliṣa nafsaka ʿan sijn al-shirk fī hādhā al-zamān wa-tajida rāʾiḥat al-miskiyya min nafaḥāt hādhihi al-ḥadīqa wa-min ʿiṭr hādhihi al-madīna tafarraqat nasamāt al-ʿiṭriyya fī aqṭār al-ʿālam wa-innaka lā taḥrim naṣībaka wa-lā takun min al-ghāfilīn.

Then, My brother, if you are a horseman of this arena, gallop through the realms of certitude, so that you may free yourself from the prison of associating partners with God in this day and catch the scent of musk from the breezes of this garden. From the perfume of this city, fragrant breezes have spread throughout the regions of the world. Do not deprive yourself of your share, and do not be among the heedless.

96

فنعم ما قال فلو عبقت فی الشّرق انفاس طیبها و فی الغرب مزکوم لعاد له الشّمّ

Fa-niʿma mā qāla fa-law ʿabaqat fī al-sharq anfāsu ṭībihā wa-fī al-gharb mazkūmun la-ʿāda lahu al-shamm.

How well he said: “If the breaths of her fragrance spread in the East, someone in the West whose nose was blocked would regain his sense of smell.”

97

و بعد هذا السّفر الالهی و هذا العروج المعنوی یدخل السّالک فی حدیقة الحیرة (حیرة تعارج روح قدسیّة فی وادی نور حیرتیّة) و هذا مقام الّذی لو القی علیک لتبکی و تنوح علی هذا العبد الّذی بقی بین یدی هؤلآء المشرکین و صار متحیّراً فی امره و یکون فی هذه اللّجّة لمن المتحیّرین بحیث فی کلّ یوم یشاورون فی قتلی و فی کلّ ساعة یریدون خروجی عن هذه البلد کما اخرجونی عن البلاد و هذا العبد اکون حاضراً بین یدیهم و انتظر ما قضی اللّه علینا و حکم بنا و قدّر لأنفسنا و ما اخاف من احد و ما احذر من نفس مع ما احاطتنا البأسآء و الضّرّآء من اهل البغی و البغضآء و اغشت الأحزان فی تلک الأزمان فطوفان نوح عند نوحی کأدمعی و ایقاد نیران الخلیل کلوعتی و حزنی ما یعقوب بثّ اقلّه و کلّ بلا ایّوب بعض بلیّتی

Wa-baʿda hādhā al-safar al-ilāhī wa-hādhā al-ʿurūj al-maʿnawī yadkhulu al-sālik fī ḥadīqat al-ḥayra (ḥayrat taʿāruj rūḥ qudsiyya fī wādī nūr ḥayriyya) wa-hādhā maqām alladhī law ulqiya ʿalayka la-tabkī wa-tanūḥu ʿalā hādhā al-ʿabd alladhī baqiya bayna yaday hāʾulāʾ al-mushrikīn wa-ṣāra mutaḥayyiran fī amrihi wa-yakūnu fī hādhihi al-lujja la-min al-mutaḥayyirīn bi-ḥaythu fī kulli yawm yushāwirūna fī qatlī wa-fī kulli sāʿa yurīdūna khurūjī ʿan hādhihi al-balad kamā akhrajūnī ʿan al-bilād wa-hādhā al-ʿabd akūnu ḥāḍiran bayna yadayhim wa-antaẓiru mā qaḍā Allāh ʿalaynā wa-ḥakama binā wa-qaddara li-anfusinā wa-mā akhāfu min aḥad wa-mā aḥdharu min nafs maʿa mā aḥāṭatnā al-baʾsāʾ wa-al-ḍarrāʾ min ahl al-baghy wa-al-baghḍāʾ wa-aghshat al-aḥzān fī tilka al-azmān fa-ṭūfānu Nūḥ ʿinda nawḥī ka-admuʿī wa-īqādu nīrān al-Khalīl ka-lawʿatī wa-ḥuznī mā Yaʿqūbu baththa aqallahu wa-kullu balā Ayyūb baʿḍu baliyyatī.

After this divine journey and this spiritual ascent, the wayfarer enters the garden of bewilderment (the bewilderment of a holy spirit’s ascent in the valley of the light of bewilderment). This is a station which, if it were disclosed to you, would make you weep and lament for this Servant, who remains in the hands of these associators of partners with God, bewildered in His plight and among those lost in wonder in this ocean. Every day they consult about killing Me, and every hour they seek My expulsion from this city, just as they expelled Me from other lands. I, this Servant, stand before them, awaiting what God has decreed for Us, ruled concerning Us, and ordained for Our souls. I fear no one and am wary of no soul, although hardship and affliction have encompassed Us at the hands of the people of oppression and hatred, and sorrows have enveloped Us in these times. “Beside My lamentation, Noah’s flood is but as My tears, and the kindling of the fires of Abraham but as My burning anguish. Jacob did not pour forth even the least of My sorrow, and all the afflictions of Job are but a portion of My tribulation.”

98

و لو اذکر لجنابک بلایا النّازلة و القضایا الواردة لتحزن علی شأن ینقطع عنک کلّ الأذکار و تغفل عن وجودک و عن کلّ ما خلق اللّه فی الملک و انّا لمّا ما اردنا لجنابک ذلک لذا غطیت اظهار القضآء فی کبد البهآء و احتجبته عمّا یتحرّک فی ارض الانشآء لیکون مکنوناً فی سرادق الغیب الی ان یظهر اللّه سرّه اذ لا یعزب عن علمه من شیء لا فی السّموات و لا فی الأرض و انّه کان بکلّ شیء رقیب

Wa-law adhkuru li-janābika balāyā al-nāzila wa-al-qaḍāyā al-wārida la-taḥzanu ʿalā shaʾn yanqaṭiʿu ʿanka kullu al-adhkār wa-taghfulu ʿan wujūdika wa-ʿan kulli mā khalaqa Allāh fī al-mulk wa-innā lammā mā aradnā li-janābika dhālika li-dhā ghaṭṭaytu iẓhār al-qaḍāʾ fī kabid al-Bahāʾ wa-iḥtajabtuhu ʿammā yataḥarraku fī arḍ al-inshāʾ li-yakūna maknūnan fī surādiq al-ghayb ilā an yuẓhira Allāh sirrahu idh lā yaʿzubu ʿan ʿilmihi min shayʾ lā fī al-samāwāt wa-lā fī al-arḍ wa-innahu kāna bi-kulli shayʾ raqīb.

Were I to recount to you the afflictions that have descended and the events that have befallen Us, you would grieve so deeply that all remembrance would cease for you, and you would become oblivious to your own existence and to everything God has created in His dominion. Since We did not desire this for you, I have concealed the disclosure of this decree within the heart of Bahāʾ and veiled it from all that moves in the land of creation, so that it may remain hidden within the pavilion of the unseen until God reveals its mystery. For nothing in the heavens or on earth escapes His knowledge, and He is watchful over all things.

99

و انّا لمّا بعدنا عن ذکر المقصود ترکنا الاشارات و رجعنا الی ما کنّا فیه فی ذکر هذه المدینة الّتی من دخل فیها نجا و من اعرض عنها هلک

Wa-innā lammā baʿudnā ʿan dhikr al-maqṣūd taraknā al-ishārāt wa-rajaʿnā ilā mā kunnā fīhi fī dhikr hādhihi al-madīna allatī man dakhala fīhā najā wa-man aʿraḍa ʿanhā halak.

Since We have strayed from the intended subject, We leave these allusions and return to Our account of this city: whoever enters it is saved, and whoever turns away from it perishes.

100

فاعرف یا ایّها المذکور فی هذه الألواح بأنّ من دخل فی هذا السّفر یکون متحیّراً فی آثار قدرة اللّه و بدائع آیات صنع اللّه و یأخذه الحیرة من کلّ الجهات و من جمیع الأطراف کما شهد بذلک جوهر البقآء فی ملإ الأعلی فی قوله ربّ زدنی فیک تحیّراً فنعم ما قال

Fa-iʿraf yā ayyuhā al-madhkūr fī hādhihi al-alwāḥ bi-anna man dakhala fī hādhā al-safar yakūnu mutaḥayyiran fī āthār qudrat Allāh wa-badāʾiʿ āyāt ṣunʿ Allāh wa-yaʾkhudhuhu al-ḥayra min kull al-jihāt wa-min jamīʿ al-aṭrāf kamā shahida bi-dhālika jawhar al-baqāʾ fī malaʾ al-aʿlā fī qawlihi rabb zidnī fīka taḥayyuran fa-niʿma mā qāl.

Know, you who are mentioned in these Tablets, that whoever embarks upon this journey becomes bewildered by the evidences of God’s power and the wondrous signs of His handiwork. Bewilderment seizes him from every direction and on every side, as the Essence of Eternity testified in the Concourse on High with His words: “My Lord, increase my bewilderment in You.” And how well it has been said:

101

و ما احترت حتّی اخترت حبّک مذهباً فوا حیرتی لو لم تکن فیک حیرتی

Wa-mā iḥtartu ḥattā ikhtartu ḥubbaka madhhaban fa-wā ḥayratī law lam takun fīka ḥayratī.

“I was not bewildered until I chose love for You as my way. How bewildered I would be if my bewilderment were not in You!”

102

و فی ذلک الوادی تضلّون السّالکون و تهلکون و لن تقدروا ان تصلوا الی مثواهم اللّه اکبر من عظمة هذا الواد و من وسعة هذه المدینة فی جبروت الایجاد کأنّک لن تجد له من اوّل و لا من آخر فبشری ثمّ بشری لمن کمل فیها سفره و ایّده اللّه علی طیّ هذه الأرض الطّیّبة فی هذه المدینة الالهیّة الّتی تتحیّر فیها کلّ المقرّبین و المخلصین و نقول الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Wa-fī dhālika al-wādī taḍillūna al-sālikūn wa-tahlikūna wa-lan taqdirū an taṣilū ilā mathwāhum Allāhu akbar min ʿaẓamat hādhā al-wād wa-min wusʿat hādhihi al-madīna fī jabarūt al-ījād ka-annaka lan tajida lahu min awwal wa-lā min ākhir fa-bushrā thumma bushrā li-man kamula fīhā safaruhu wa-ayyadahu Allāh ʿalā ṭayy hādhihi al-arḍ al-ṭayyiba fī hādhihi al-madīna al-ilāhiyya allatī tataḥayyaru fīhā kullu al-muqarrabīn wa-al-mukhliṣīn wa-naqūlu al-ḥamdu li-llāh rabb al-ʿālamīn.

In that valley you wayfarers lose your way and perish, and you cannot reach their abode. God is greater than the grandeur of this valley and the vastness of this city in the dominion of creation! It is as though you could find neither its beginning nor its end. Glad tidings, then, glad tidings to the one whose journey within it is complete, whom God has aided to traverse this goodly land in this divine city, where all who are brought near and all who are sincere are bewildered. And We say: “Praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds.”

103

و لو یتعارج العبد و یسافر عن هذا الوطن التّرابی و یرید ان یتعارج الی وطن الالهی لیدخل من هذه المدینة الی مدینة الفنآء (فنآء تغرّد محو [الهیّة] فی حدیقة صعق فنائیّة) لفنائه عن نفسه و بقائه باللّه و السّالک فی هذا المقام و هذا الوطن البحت الأعلی و هذا السّفر المحو الکبری لینسی نفسه و روحه و جسده و ذاته و یسبح فی قلزم الفنآء و یکون فی الأرض کمن لم یکن شیئاً مذکورا و لن یشهد احد منه آثار الوجود لاضمحلاله عن ممالک الشّهود و لبلوغه الی مقامات المحو

Wa-law yataʿāraju al-ʿabd wa-yusāfiru ʿan hādhā al-waṭan al-turābī wa-yurīdu an yataʿāraja ilā waṭan al-ilāhī li-yadkhula min hādhihi al-madīna ilā madīnat al-fanāʾ (fanāʾ tagharrud maḥw [ilāhiyya] fī ḥadīqat ṣaʿq fanāʾiyya) li-fanāʾihi ʿan nafsihi wa-baqāʾihi bi-llāh wa-al-sālik fī hādhā al-maqām wa-hādhā al-waṭan al-baḥt al-aʿlā wa-hādhā al-safar al-maḥw al-kubrā la-yansā nafsahu wa-rūḥahu wa-jasadahu wa-dhātahu wa-yasbaḥu fī qulzum al-fanāʾ wa-yakūnu fī al-arḍ ka-man lam yakun shayʾan madhkūran wa-lan yashhada aḥadun minhu āthār al-wujūd li-iḍmiḥlālihi ʿan mamālik al-shuhūd wa-li-bulūghihi ilā maqāmāt al-maḥw.

Should the servant ascend and journey away from this earthly homeland, desiring to ascend to the divine homeland, he will enter from this city into the city of annihilation (the annihilation of the singing of [divine] effacement in the garden of the swoon of annihilation), through his annihilation of self and his abiding in God. In this station, this pure and most exalted homeland, this journey of supreme effacement, the wayfarer forgets his self, his spirit, his body, and his being. He swims in the ocean of annihilation and is on earth as one who was not a thing worthy of mention. No one will perceive in him any traces of existence, for he has vanished from the realms of the visible and attained the stations of effacement.

104

و لو انّا نذکر اسرار هذه المدینة لتفنی ممالک الفؤاد لکثرة شوق اهلها الی هذا المقام السّداد لأنّ هذا المقام مقام تجلّی المعشوق للعاشق الصّادق و ظهور اشراق انوار المحبوب للحبیب الفارغ

Wa-law innā nadhkuru asrār hādhihi al-madīna la-tafnā mamālik al-fuʾād li-kathrat shawq ahlihā ilā hādhā al-maqām al-sadād li-anna hādhā al-maqām maqām tajallī al-maʿshūq li-al-ʿāshiq al-ṣādiq wa-ẓuhūr ishrāq anwār al-maḥbūb li-al-ḥabīb al-fārigh.

Were We to recount the mysteries of this city, the realms of the heart would perish from their inhabitants’ intense longing for this station of rectitude. For this is the station where the Beloved reveals Himself to the true lover, and where the radiance of the Loved One’s lights appears to the lover who is free of all attachment.

105

و هل یمکن للعاشق وجود حین تجلّی المعشوق او للظّلّ بقآء عند ظهور الشّمس او للحبیب دوام عند وجود المحبوب لا فوالّذی نفسی بیده بل السّالک فی هذا المقام لو تفحّص فی شرق الأرض و غربها و برّها و بحرها و سهلها و جبلها ما یجد نفسه و لا نفس غیره لشدّة فنائه فی موجده و لطافة محوه فی بارئه

Wa-hal yumkinu li-al-ʿāshiq wujūd ḥīna tajallī al-maʿshūq aw li-al-ẓill baqāʾ ʿinda ẓuhūr al-shams aw li-al-ḥabīb dawām ʿinda wujūd al-maḥbūb lā fa-wa-alladhī nafsī bi-yadihi bal al-sālik fī hādhā al-maqām law tafaḥḥaṣa fī sharq al-arḍ wa-gharbihā wa-barrihā wa-baḥrihā wa-sahlihā wa-jabalihā mā yajidu nafsahu wa-lā nafsa ghayrihi li-shiddat fanāʾihi fī mūjidihi wa-laṭāfat maḥwihi fī bāriʾihi.

Can the lover have any existence when the Beloved reveals Himself, or the shadow remain when the sun appears, or the lover endure in the presence of the Loved One? No, by Him in whose hand is My soul! Indeed, were the wayfarer in this station to search the east and west of the earth, its land and sea, its plains and mountains, he would find neither himself nor anyone else, so complete is his annihilation in the One who brought him into being, and so subtle his effacement in his Creator.

106

فسبحان اللّه لو لا خوفی من نمرود الظّلم و حفظی لخلیل العدل لألقی علیک ما یغنیک عن دونک و لأقرأ لک ما یقرّبک الی هذه المدینة حین غفلة عن نفسک و هواک ولکن اصبر حتّی یأتی اللّه بأمره و انّه هو یجزی الصّابرین بغیر حساب اذاً فانشق رائحة الرّوحانی من قمص المعانی و قل یا اهل لجّة الفنآء ان اسرعوا للدّخول فی مدینة البقآء ان انتم الی معارج البقآء تتعارجون و نقول انّا للّه و انّا الیه راجعون

Fa-subḥāna Allāh law lā khawfī min Nimrūd al-ẓulm wa-ḥifẓī li-Khalīl al-ʿadl la-ulqī ʿalayka mā yughnīka ʿan dūnika wa-la-aqraʾu laka mā yuqarribuka ilā hādhihi al-madīna ḥīna ghaflatin ʿan nafsika wa-hawāka wa-lākin iṣbir ḥattā yaʾtiya Allāh bi-amrihi wa-innahu huwa yajzī al-ṣābirīn bi-ghayri ḥisāb idhan fa-inshaq rāʾiḥat al-rūḥānī min qumuṣ al-maʿānī wa-qul yā ahl lujjat al-fanāʾ an asriʿū li-al-dukhūl fī madīnat al-baqāʾ in antum ilā maʿārij al-baqāʾ tataʿārajūn wa-naqūlu innā li-llāh wa-innā ilayhi rājiʿūn.

Glory be to God! Were it not for My fear of the Nimrod of oppression and My protection of the Abraham of justice, I would impart to you what would make you independent of all besides yourself, and recite to you what would bring you near this city when you are oblivious to your self and your desires. But be patient until God brings forth His command. He indeed rewards the patient without measure. Breathe, then, the spiritual fragrance from the garments of inner meanings, and say: “People of the ocean of annihilation, hasten to enter the city of abiding, if you would ascend the ascending paths of abiding.” And We say: “We belong to God, and to Him we return.”

107

و من ذلک المقام الأعلی الأعلی و الرّتبة الأعظم الأسنی یدخل فی مدینة البقآء (بقآء تغنّی ورقآء دائمیّة فی وادی قدس بقائیّة) علی البقآء و فی ذلک المقام یشهد السّالک نفسه علی عرش الاستغنآء و کرسیّ الاستعلآء اذاً یظهر له حکم ما ذکر من قبل یوم یغنی اللّه کلّاً من سعته فهنیئاً لمن وصل الی هذا المقام و شرب من هذا الکأس البیضآء فی هذا الرّکن الحمرآء

Wa-min dhālika al-maqām al-aʿlā al-aʿlā wa-al-rutba al-aʿẓam al-asnā yadkhulu fī madīnat al-baqāʾ (baqāʾ taghannī warqāʾ dāʾimiyya fī wādī quds baqāʾiyya) ʿalā al-baqāʾ wa-fī dhālika al-maqām yashhadu al-sālik nafsahu ʿalā ʿarsh al-istighnāʾ wa-kursī al-istiʿlāʾ idhan yaẓharu lahu ḥukm mā dhukira min qabl yawma yughnī Allāhu kullan min saʿatihi fa-hanīʾan li-man waṣala ilā hādhā al-maqām wa-shariba min hādhā al-kaʾs al-bayḍāʾ fī hādhā al-rukn al-ḥamrāʾ.

From that most exalted, most exalted station and that greatest, most resplendent rank, he enters the city of abiding (the abiding of the singing of an everlasting dove in the valley of the holiness of abiding), to abide there. In that station the wayfarer beholds himself upon the throne of independence and the seat of exaltation. Then the import of what was said before becomes apparent to him: “The day when God enriches everyone out of His abundance.” Blessed is the one who has reached this station and drunk from this white cup in this crimson sanctuary.

108

فانّ السّالک فی هذا السّفر لمّا استغرق فی ابحر البقآء و استفرغ فؤاده عن کلّ ما سواه و استبلغ الی معارج الحیاة لا یری الفنآء لنفسه و لا لغیره ابداً و یشرب عن کأس البقآء و یمشی فی ارض البقآء و یطیر فی هوآء البقآء و یجالس مع هیاکل البقآء و یأکل من نعمة الباقیة الدّائمة من شجرة الدّائمة الأزلیّة و یکون من اهل البقآء فی علی البقآء بالبقآء مذکورا

Fa-inna al-sālik fī hādhā al-safar lammā istaghraqa fī abḥur al-baqāʾ wa-istafragha fuʾādahu ʿan kull mā siwāhu wa-istablagha ilā maʿārij al-ḥayāh lā yarā al-fanāʾ li-nafsihi wa-lā li-ghayrihi abadan wa-yashrab ʿan kaʾs al-baqāʾ wa-yamshī fī arḍ al-baqāʾ wa-yaṭīr fī hawāʾ al-baqāʾ wa-yujālis maʿa hayākil al-baqāʾ wa-yaʾkul min niʿmat al-bāqiyah al-dāʾimah min shajarat al-dāʾimah al-azaliyyah wa-yakūn min ahl al-baqāʾ fī ʿulā al-baqāʾ bi-l-baqāʾ madhkūran.

For when the wayfarer on this journey becomes immersed in the oceans of abiding, empties his heart of all else, and reaches the ascending heights of life, he never sees annihilation for himself or for anyone else. He drinks from the cup of abiding, walks in the land of abiding, flies in the air of abiding, sits with the embodiments of abiding, and partakes of enduring, everlasting bounty from the everlasting, eternal tree. He is numbered among the people of abiding, remembered through abiding in the heights of abiding.

109

و کلّ ما یکون فی هذه المدینة لباقیة دائمة لا یفنی و انت لو تدخل باذن اللّه فی هذه الحدیقة العالیة المتعالیة لتجد شمسها فی قطب الزّوال بحیث لا تکسف و لا تغرب ابداً و کذلک قمرها و افلاکها و انجمها و اشجرها و ابحرها و کلّ ما فیها و بها و انّی فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو لو اذکر لک بدائع اوصاف هذه المدینة من یومئذ الی آخر الّذی لا آخر له ما یفرغ حبّ فؤادی لهذه المدینة الطّیّبة الدّائمة ولکن اختم القول لضیق الوقت و تعجیل الطّالب و لئلّا تظهر الأسرار فی الاجهار من دون اذن من اللّه المقتدر القهّار

Wa-kull mā yakūn fī hādhihi al-madīnah la-bāqiyah dāʾimah lā yafnā wa-anta law tadkhul bi-idhn Allāh fī hādhihi al-ḥadīqah al-ʿāliyah al-mutaʿāliyah la-tajid shamsahā fī quṭb al-zawāl bi-ḥaythu lā tuksaf wa-lā taghrub abadan wa-kadhālika qamaruhā wa-aflākuhā wa-anjumuhā wa-ashjaruhā wa-abḥuruhā wa-kull mā fīhā wa-bihā wa-innī fa-wa-Allāh alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa law adhkur laka badāʾiʿ awṣāf hādhihi al-madīnah min yawmiʾidh ilā ākhir alladhī lā ākhir lahu mā yafragh ḥubb fuʾādī li-hādhihi al-madīnah al-ṭayyibah al-dāʾimah wa-lākin akhtim al-qawl li-ḍīq al-waqt wa-taʿjīl al-ṭālib wa-li-allā taẓhar al-asrār fī al-ijhār min dūn idhn min Allāh al-Muqtadir al-Qahhār.

Everything in this city is enduring and everlasting, never passing away. Were you, by God’s permission, to enter this lofty and exalted garden, you would find its sun at the zenith, never eclipsed and never setting. So too are its moon, its heavens, its stars, its trees, its seas, and everything within it and belonging to it. By God, besides whom there is no other god, were I to recount to you the wondrous attributes of this city from this day until the end that has no end, My heart’s love for this good and everlasting city would not be exhausted. But I bring these words to a close because time is short and the seeker is pressing, and so that the mysteries may not be openly disclosed without permission from God, the All-Powerful, the All-Subduing.

110

و سینظر الموحّدون فی قیامة الأخری بأنّ من یظهره اللّه مع هذه المدینة ینزل من سمآء الغیب مع ملائکة المقرّبین العالین فطوبی لمن یحضر بین یدیه و یفوز بلقائه و انّا کلّ بذلک آملون و نقول الحمد لله اذ هو الحقّ و انّا کلّ الیه منقلبون

Wa-sa-yanẓur al-muwaḥḥidūn fī qiyāmat al-ukhrā bi-anna man yuẓhiruhu Allāh maʿa hādhihi al-madīnah yanzil min samāʾ al-ghayb maʿa malāʾikat al-muqarrabīn al-ʿālīn fa-ṭūbā li-man yaḥḍur bayna yadayhi wa-yafūz bi-liqāʾihi wa-innā kull bi-dhālika āmilūn wa-naqūl al-ḥamdu li-llāh idh huwa al-Ḥaqq wa-innā kull ilayhi munqalibūn.

In the resurrection to come, those who affirm God’s unity will behold Him whom God will make manifest descending with this city from the heaven of the unseen, accompanied by the angels who are exalted and brought near. Blessed is the one who enters His presence and attains reunion with Him. We all hope for this, and We say: “Praise be to God, for He is the Truth, and to Him we shall all return.”

111

ثمّ اعرف بأنّ الواصل الی هذه المقامات و المسافر فی هذه الأسفار لو یناله فی السّبیل من کبر او غرور لیهلک فی الحین و یرجع الی قدم الأوّل من دون ان یعرف ذلک و علامة الواصلین و المشتاقین فی هذه الأسفار ان یخفضوا جناحهم للّذین آمنوا باللّه و آیاته و یبخعوا انفسهم للّذین استقربوا الی اللّه و مظاهر جماله و یخضعوا ذواتهم للّذین استقرّوا علی رفرف امر اللّه و عظمته

Thumma iʿraf bi-anna al-wāṣil ilā hādhihi al-maqāmāt wa-al-musāfir fī hādhihi al-asfār law yanāluhu fī al-sabīl min kibr aw ghurūr la-yahlak fī al-ḥīn wa-yarjiʿ ilā qadam al-awwal min dūn an yaʿrif dhālika wa-ʿalāmat al-wāṣilīn wa-al-mushtāqīn fī hādhihi al-asfār an yakhfiḍū janāḥahum li-lladhīna āmanū bi-Allāh wa-āyātihi wa-yabkhaʿū anfusahum li-lladhīna istaqrabū ilā Allāh wa-maẓāhir jamālihi wa-yakhḍaʿū dhawātahum li-lladhīna istaqarrū ʿalā rafraf amr Allāh wa-ʿaẓamatihi.

Know, then, that if anyone who reaches these stations and travels on these journeys is touched by pride or conceit along the way, he will perish at once and return to the first step without realizing it. The sign of those who have arrived and those who yearn on these journeys is that they lower their wings before those who believe in God and His verses, humble themselves before those who have drawn near to God and the Manifestations of His beauty, and bow before those established upon the lofty seat of God’s Cause and grandeur.

112

لأنّهم لو یتعارجون الی غایة القصوی فی سلوکهم الی اللّه و وصولهم الیه لن یصلوا الّا الی مقرّ الّذی خلقت فی افئدتهنّ فکیف یقدرنّ ان یتعارجنّ الی مقامات الّتی ما قدّرت لهم و ما خلقت لشأنهم و لو یسافرون من الأزل الی الأبد لن یصلوا الی قطب الوجود و مرکز الموجود الّذی جری عن یمینه بحور العظمة و عن یساره شطوط القدرة و لن یقدر احد ان ینزل بفنائه و کیف الی مقامه و هو کان ساکناً فی فلک النّار و یسری علی بحر النّار فی کرة النّار و یمشی فی هوآء النّار فکیف یقدر من خلق بالأضداد ان یدخل فی النّار او یقرب بها و ان یقربها لیحترق فی الحین

Li-annahum law yataʿārajūn ilā ghāyat al-quṣwā fī sulūkihim ilā Allāh wa-wuṣūlihim ilayhi lan yaṣilū illā ilā maqarr alladhī khuliqat fī afʾidatihinna fa-kayfa yaqdiranna an yataʿārajna ilā maqāmāt allatī mā quddirat lahum wa-mā khuliqat li-shaʾnihim wa-law yusāfirūn min al-azal ilā al-abad lan yaṣilū ilā quṭb al-wujūd wa-markaz al-mawjūd alladhī jarā ʿan yamīnihi buḥūr al-ʿaẓamah wa-ʿan yasārihi shuṭūṭ al-qudrah wa-lan yaqdir aḥad an yanzil bi-fināʾihi wa-kayfa ilā maqāmihi wa-huwa kāna sākinan fī fulk al-nār wa-yasrī ʿalā baḥr al-nār fī kurat al-nār wa-yamshī fī hawāʾ al-nār fa-kayfa yaqdir man khuliqa bi-l-aḍdād an yadkhul fī al-nār aw yaqrub bihā wa-in yaqrabhā la-yaḥtariq fī al-ḥīn.

For even if they ascend to the furthest limit in their journey toward God and their attainment of Him, they will reach only the dwelling created within their own hearts. How, then, could they ascend to stations that have not been ordained for them or created for their condition? Even if they journey from eternity to eternity, they will never reach the Pole of existence and the Center of being, to whose right flow the seas of grandeur and to whose left flow the rivers of power. No one can alight in His courtyard, much less attain His station. He dwells in the ark of fire, sails upon the sea of fire within the sphere of fire, and walks in the air of fire. How, then, can one created of opposites enter the fire or draw near it? If he approaches it, he will burn at once.

113

ثمّ اعلم بأنّ هذا القطب الأعظم لو یقطع خیط مدده عن کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض لتنعدم کلّهنّ فسبحان اللّه کیف یصل التّراب الی ربّ الأرباب فسبحان اللّه عمّا یظنّون فی انفسهم و تعالی عمّا هم یذکرون

Thumma iʿlam bi-anna hādhā al-quṭb al-aʿẓam law yaqṭaʿ khayṭ madadihi ʿan kull man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ la-tanʿadim kulluhunna fa-subḥān Allāh kayfa yaṣil al-turāb ilā Rabb al-arbāb fa-subḥān Allāh ʿammā yaẓunnūn fī anfusihim wa-taʿālā ʿammā hum yadhkurūn.

Know, then, that if this most great Pole were to sever the thread of His sustaining grace from all who are in the heavens and on earth, they would all cease to exist. Glory be to God! How can dust reach the Lord of lords? God is far above what they imagine within themselves, and exalted beyond what they say.

114

بلی انّ السّالک یتعارج الی مقام الّذی لا غایة له فیما قدّر له و یجد فی قلبه نار الحبّ بحیث یأخذ زمام الاختیار عن هؤلآء الأخیار و فی کلّ حین یزداد فی حبّه مولاه و اقباله الی بارئه بحیث لو کان مولاه فی مشرق القربیّة و هو فی مغرب البعدیّة و کان له ملء السّموات و الأرض من اللّؤلؤ الحمرآء و الذّهب الصّفرآء لینفق و یرکض بعینیه لیصل الی ارض الّتی کان المقصود فیها و لو تجد السّالک بغیر ذلک فاعلم بأنّه کذّاب مفتر انّا لمن یظهره اللّه فی قیامة الأخری و انّا به لمبعثون

Balā inna al-sālik yataʿāraj ilā maqām alladhī lā ghāyah lahu fīmā quddira lahu wa-yajid fī qalbihi nār al-ḥubb bi-ḥaythu yaʾkhudh zimām al-ikhtiyār ʿan hāʾulāʾ al-akhyār wa-fī kull ḥīn yazdād fī ḥubbihi mawlāhu wa-iqbālihi ilā bāriʾihi bi-ḥaythu law kāna mawlāhu fī mashriq al-qurbiyyah wa-huwa fī maghrib al-buʿdiyyah wa-kāna lahu milʾ al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ min al-luʾluʾ al-ḥamrāʾ wa-al-dhahab al-ṣafrāʾ la-yunfiq wa-yarkuḍ bi-ʿaynayhi li-yaṣil ilā arḍ allatī kāna al-Maqṣūd fīhā wa-law tajid al-sālik bi-ghayr dhālika fa-iʿlam bi-annahu kadhdhāb muftarin innā li-man yuẓhiruhu Allāh fī qiyāmat al-ukhrā wa-innā bihi la-mabʿūthūn.

Indeed, the wayfarer ascends to a station without limit within what has been ordained for him, and finds in his heart the fire of love, so intense that it wrests the reins of choice from these righteous souls. At every moment he grows in love for his Lord and in his turning toward his Creator, to such a degree that, were his Lord in the east of nearness and he in the west of remoteness, and were he to possess red pearls and yellow gold enough to fill the heavens and the earth, he would spend it all and hasten on his very eyes to reach the land where the Desired One dwells. If you find the wayfarer otherwise, know that he is a lying impostor. We belong to Him whom God will make manifest in the resurrection to come, and through Him we shall be raised.

115

و فی تلک الأیّام لمّا ما کشفنا الغطآء عن وجه الأمر و ما [ظهرنا] للعباد ثمرات هذه المقامات الّتی منعنا عن اظهارها لذا تجدهم فی سکران الغفلة والّا لو کشف لکلّ من علی الأرض اقلّ من سمّ الابرة من هذا المقام لتشهد کیف یجتمعون فی فنآء رحمة اللّه و یرکضون من کلّ الأطراف للبلوغ الی ساحة القرب فی رفرف عزّة اللّه ولکن اخفینا لما ذکرنا من قبل و لیمتاز المؤمنون عن المنکرین و المقبلون عن المعرضین و اقول لا حول و لا قوّة الّا باللّه المهیمن القیّوم

Wa-fī tilka al-ayyām lammā mā kashafnā al-ghiṭāʾ ʿan wajh al-amr wa-mā [ẓaharnā] li-l-ʿibād thamarāt hādhihi al-maqāmāt allatī muniʿnā ʿan iẓhārihā li-dhā tajiduhum fī sukrān al-ghaflah wa-illā law kushifa li-kull man ʿalā al-arḍ aqall min samm al-ibrah min hādhā al-maqām la-tashhad kayfa yajtamiʿūn fī fināʾ raḥmat Allāh wa-yarkuḍūn min kull al-aṭrāf li-l-bulūgh ilā sāḥat al-qurb fī rafraf ʿizzat Allāh wa-lākin akhfaynā li-mā dhakarnā min qabl wa-li-yamtāz al-muʾminūn ʿan al-munkirīn wa-al-muqbilūn ʿan al-muʿriḍīn wa-aqūl lā ḥawl wa-lā quwwah illā bi-Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm.

In these days, since We have not lifted the veil from the face of the Cause or [shown] the servants the fruits of these stations, which We have been prevented from revealing, you find them drunk with heedlessness. Otherwise, were less than a needle’s eye of this station disclosed to everyone on earth, you would see how they would gather in the courtyard of God’s mercy and hasten from every direction to reach the precinct of nearness upon the lofty seat of God’s might. But We have concealed it for the reasons We mentioned before, and so that the believers may be distinguished from the deniers, and those who turn toward Him from those who turn away. And I say: “There is no strength or power except through God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.”

116

و یسترقی السّالک من هذا المقام الی مدینة (غیب تصاعد قدس ازلیّة فی طلعة غیب سرّیّة) الّتی لم یکن لها من اسم و لا رسم و لا ذکر و لا صوت تجری فیها بحور القدم و تدور فی حول القدم و تشرق فیها شمس الغیب عن افق الغیب و لها افلاک من نفسها و اقمار من نورها کلّهنّ یطلعن من بحر الغیب و یدخلن فی بحر الغیب و انّی ما اقدر ان اذکر رشحاً عمّا قدّر فیها و لا یطّلع علی اسرارها احد الّا اللّه و مظاهر نفسه اذ هو خالقها و مبدعها

Wa-yastarqī al-sālik min hādhā al-maqām ilā madīnat (ghayb taṣāʿud quds azaliyyah fī ṭalʿat ghayb sirriyyah) allatī lam yakun lahā min ism wa-lā rasm wa-lā dhikr wa-lā ṣawt tajrī fīhā buḥūr al-qidam wa-tadūr fī ḥawl al-qidam wa-tushriq fīhā shams al-ghayb ʿan ufuq al-ghayb wa-lahā aflāk min nafsihā wa-aqmār min nūrihā kulluhunna yaṭluʿna min baḥr al-ghayb wa-yadkhulna fī baḥr al-ghayb wa-innī mā aqdir an adhkur rashḥan ʿammā quddira fīhā wa-lā yaṭṭaliʿ ʿalā asrārihā aḥad illā Allāh wa-maẓāhir nafsihi idh huwa khāliquhā wa-mubdiʿuhā.

From this station the wayfarer ascends to the city (the unseen ascent of eternal holiness in the countenance of a hidden mystery), which has no name, no trace, no mention, and no sound. Within it flow the seas of eternity, and they circle around eternity. Within it the sun of the unseen shines from the horizon of the unseen. It has heavens of its own and moons of its own light, all rising from the sea of the unseen and entering the sea of the unseen. I cannot mention even a sprinkling of what has been ordained within it. No one knows its mysteries except God and the Manifestations of His own Self, for He is its Creator and Originator.

117

ثمّ اعلم بأنّا حین الّذی اردنا ان نتعرّض بتلک الکلمات و کتبنا بعضها اردنا بأن نفسّر لجنابک کلّ ما ذکرنا من قبل من کلمات النّبیّین و عبارات المرسلین بنغمات المقرّبین و ربوات المقدّسین ولکن ما وجدنا الفرصة و ما شهدنا المهلة من هذا المسافر الّذی جآء من عندکم و کان عجولاً فی الأمر و راکضاً فی الحکم لذا قد اختصرنا و اکتفینا و ما اتممنا ذکر الأسفار بتمامها و ما ینبغی لها و یلیق بها بل ترکنا ذکر مدائن الکبری و اسفار العظمی و بلغ تعجیل الرّافع الی مقام الّذی ترکنا ذکر السّفرین الأعلیین فی التّسلیم و الرّضا

Thumma iʿlam bi-annā ḥīn alladhī aradnā an nataʿarraḍ bi-tilka al-kalimāt wa-katabnā baʿḍahā aradnā bi-an nufassir li-janābika kull mā dhakarnā min qabl min kalimāt al-nabiyyīn wa-ʿibārāt al-mursalīn bi-naghamāt al-muqarrabīn wa-rabawāt al-muqaddasīn wa-lākin mā wajadnā al-furṣah wa-mā shahidnā al-muhlah min hādhā al-musāfir alladhī jāʾa min ʿindikum wa-kāna ʿajūlan fī al-amr wa-rākiḍan fī al-ḥukm li-dhā qad ikhtaṣarnā wa-iktafaynā wa-mā atmamnā dhikr al-asfār bi-tamāmihā wa-mā yanbaghī lahā wa-yalīq bihā bal taraknā dhikr madāʾin al-kubrā wa-asfār al-ʿuẓmā wa-balagha taʿjīl al-rāfiʿ ilā maqām alladhī taraknā dhikr al-safrayn al-aʿlayayn fī al-taslīm wa-al-riḍā.

Know, then, that when We wished to address these words and had written some of them, We intended to explain to you everything We had previously mentioned of the words of the Prophets and the utterances of the Messengers, in the melodies of those brought near and upon the heights of the sanctified. But We found no opportunity and were granted no respite by this traveler who came from you, for he was hasty in the matter and hurried in his decision. We have therefore been brief and contented Ourselves with this, and have not completed the account of all the journeys as would be fitting and appropriate. Rather, We have left unmentioned the greater cities and the mightier journeys. The bearer’s haste reached such a point that We left unmentioned the two most exalted journeys, those of surrender and contentment.

118

ولو انّ جنابک لو تفکّر فی هذه الکلمات المختصرات لتعرف کلّ العلوم و تصل الی ذروة المعلوم و تقول یکفی کلّ الوجود من المشهود و المفقود

Wa-law anna janābaka law tafakkar fī hādhihi al-kalimāt al-mukhtaṣarāt la-taʿrif kull al-ʿulūm wa-taṣil ilā dhirwat al-Maʿlūm wa-taqūl yakfī kull al-wujūd min al-mashhūd wa-al-mafqūd.

Yet, were you to reflect on these brief words, you would come to know all knowledge, attain the summit of the Known, and say: “This suffices for all existence, both what is seen and what is absent.”

119

ولکن لو تجد فی نفسک حرارة المحبّة لتقول هل من مزید و نقول الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Wa-lākin law tajid fī nafsika ḥarārat al-maḥabbah la-taqūl hal min mazīd wa-naqūl al-ḥamdu li-llāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn.

But if you find within yourself the heat of love, you will say: “Is there more?” And We say: “Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.”

Lawḥ Shams al-Ḥaqq (Tablet of the Sun of Truth)
BH00013 (Unnamed)
